name: Act 1
summary: Exile washes up on the Twilight Strand, reaches Lioneye's Watch, defeats Brutus in Axiom Prison and Merveil in her lair; monster levels 1-13.

name: Act 10: Return to Oriath
summary: Tenth and final act. With Lilly Roth's help the exile returns to ruined Oriath, finds Bannon, awakens Innocence and kills Kitava in the Feeding Trough. Monster levels 64-67.

name: Act 2 - Phrecia
summary: Forest Encampment act: the exile deals with three bandit lords, follows Piety's Blackguards, and ends the act by killing the Vaal Oversoul; levels 13-23.

name: Act 3 - Sarn
summary: The ruined Eternal capital Sarn, infested with undead and Blackguards; Dominus and Piety experiment with virtue gems; ends with Dominus in the Sceptre of God; levels 23-33.

name: Act 4 - Highgate
summary: Maraketh-held Highgate mining town; with Lady Dialla's help the exile enters the Beast and kills Malachai; levels 33-40.

name: Act 5 - Oriath
summary: The Fall of Oriath: slave rebellion against the Templars, Avarius and Innocence fall, Utula summons Kitava; levels 41-45.

name: Act 6: The Rising Tide
summary: Sixth act and start of Part Two. After failing to stop Kitava's reawakening the exile flees Oriath and returns to Wraeclast, guided by Sin, who plans to harvest souls for a Dark Ember; the exile faces Tukohama, Abberath, Ryslatha and the Brine King. Town: Lioneye's Watch; monster levels 45-50.

name: Act 7: Lord and Legion
summary: Seventh act. The exile lands at the Broken Bridge (Bridge Encampment); Sin asks for Maligaro's soul while Ralakesh possesses Greust and Silk consorts with Arakaali. Monster levels 51-54.

name: Act 8: Eclipse
summary: Eighth act. The exile returns to the Sarn Encampment to find Doedre in the sewers while the sun and moon goddesses Solaris and Lunaris awaken and battle. Monster levels 55-60.

name: Act 9: Reunion
summary: Ninth act. The exile returns to Highgate, whose waters run red with the dead Beast's blood; Sin's plan is to wake a Dark Ember from the Beast's corpse. Kira/Garukhan, Shakari and the Depraved Trinity are faced. Monster levels 61-64.

name: Epilogue
summary: The post-campaign epilogue: after Kitava's death Lilly Roth offers to sail the exile away ('Toward the Future'); the exile arrives in Karui Shores, where Helena and Commander Kirac introduce the Atlas of Worlds. Earlier versions of the Epilogue were set in rebuilding Oriath.

sources.locator: Overview: 'transition directly into the Epilogue, leading to Karui Shores and The Atlas of Worlds'

name: The Allflame
summary: Mysterious flame whose Embers (Necropolis) transform monsters via the Lantern; its light returns in Allflame league as a growing, hungry power that Vesper says differs from the light of the pit below the sea.

alt_summaries.summary: A mythical flame in a silver lantern found by Fairgraves in a shattered Empire cathedral; it must be kindled with life.

name: An Audience With The King
summary: Map fragment that grants access to The King in the Mists boss fight at the Crux of Nothingness; it can appear as a reward from Ritual encounters and was added in 3.25.0.

name: Ankh of Eternity
summary: Resurrection artefact used by Veruso to revive Chiara; per Clarissa the ritual produced a monster. Later hidden in the Quay.

alt_summaries.summary: Artefact said to have power over life and death, placed in a shrine in the Quay by Veruso, Prima Imperialus, at the dawn of the Empire. Clarissa's ritual with it fails; she realises Veruso hid it out of fear over what it did to his wife Chiara and decides to destroy it.

name: Atlas Book of Skill
summary: Consumable reward item that grants one or more Atlas passive skill points and Atlas passive respec points when used. It is obtained from Commander Kirac or Eagon Caeserius after defeating specific pinnacle bosses. An 'Eldritch' variant is the reward of The Searing Exarch and The Eater of Worlds quests.

sources.locator: intro: 'obtained from either Kirac or Eagon after defeating specific pinnacle bosses'; Eldritch variant named in The Searing Exarch and The Eater of Worlds walkthroughs

name: Baleful Gem
summary: Maligaro's creation of calibric extantia guarded in the Chamber of Sins, used to poison Lorrata; Piety wanted it.

name: Black Elixir
summary: Poison from the Baleful Gem and Black Death venom, used by Ondar to kill Chitus.

name: Blood Crucible
summary: Device that lets the player shift into the Nightmare and corrupt items; per The Last to Die it represents a pact between Chaos and the bloodlines of Vaal High Priests, functioning only while the last bloodline lives.

name: Breachstone
summary: Item combined from Breach splinters (5 types, one per Breachlord) to open the Breachlord's Domain via map device; Flawless variant added 3.16; removed with Breach rework in 3.28.

sources.locator: lead: splinters combine into a Breachstone to challenge the Breachlord

name: Brutal Restraint
summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Maraketh variant. Conquers passives in radius with service of dekhara in the akhara of Asenath, Balbala or Nasima; transforms keystones into exclusive ones. Drops from the Maraketh legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.

sources.locator: Infobox: explicit1_text 'Denoted service of (500-8000) dekhara in the akhara of <Asenath • Balbala • Nasima>'; drop_text 'Maraketh legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

name: Chitus' master gem
summary: Large gem in Chitus' chest linking each gemling's heartbeat to his.

sources.locator: Issue 4 The Black Heart, p. 11 (cited by wiki)

name: Cosmic Arcana
summary: Weapon Valdo designed against the Elder; Zana found his key and used it to expel the Elder from the Atlas.

name: The Dark Ember
summary: The seed from which Sin grew the Beast beneath Highgate. After the Beast's death Sin plans to rekindle a residue of it from the souls of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre to give the exile a chance against Kitava.

sources.locator: dialogue 'The Dark Ember' / 'Shavronne': "The very seed that brought my Beast into existence. The Dark Ember."
'The Beast': Sin planted the Dark Ember beneath Highgate
Sin: "The very seed that brought my Beast into existence. The Dark Ember."

alt_summaries.summary: Seed Sin planted beneath Highgate; the Beast grew from it.
Seed from which the Beast grew; its residue after the Beast's death is extracted by the Exile and Sin from the Beast's core using the souls of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre, and used against Kitava.

name: Deshret's Banner
summary: Key to opening the seal on the Highgate mines; taken by Voll after killing Deshret, retrieved in Act 4.

alt_summaries.summary: Banner taken by Voll from Deshret; breaks her Seal on the Mines.

name: Elegant Hubris
summary: Eternal Empire Timeless Jewel (Legion 3.7.0) naming Cadiro, Victario and Caspiro (the last per wiki list of historical figures: Bust of Emperor Caspiro).

name: Eye of Desire
summary: Taken from Daresso's spirit, used to power the Rapture Device.

alt_summaries.summary: Gem held by Daresso, needed for the Rapture Device.

name: Eye of Fury
summary: Taken from Kaom at Highgate, used to power the Rapture Device.

alt_summaries.summary: Gem held by Kaom, needed for the Rapture Device.

name: Eyes of Zeal
summary: Casticus's faithful eyes, the key to the Templar Courts.

name: The Genesis Tree
summary: Living tree at the Monastery of the Keepers that consumes Hiveborn remains and hiveblood to birth wombgifts.

sources.locator: Allocate a Womb; Quest Complete bonded with the Genesis Tree

alt_summaries.summary: Tree in the Monastery that consumes Graftblood and births rewards (wombgifts); Exile bonds with it to complete Into the Breach.

name: Glorious Vanity
summary: Vaal Timeless Jewel (Legion 3.7.0); its mods name Doryani ('bathed in the blood of ... sacrificed in the name of Doryani'); other variants name Xibaqua and Ahuatotli.

name: Golden Pages
summary: Vaal artefacts describing the Vaal Cataclysm that Malachai had Icius Perandus translate (wiki: 'possibly the Golden Pages'); the translation inspired the Reverie Device.

name: Horns of Kulamac
summary: Artifact guarded by the Order of the Djinn in the Forbidden Vaults, described by Jun as able to shift the energies of life freely; its origin is unknown even to Jun. Catarina, helped by Janus Perandus, took it; Jun believes it grants the Syndicate immortality (her belief only).

sources.locator: 20:19 horns of Kulamac; 21:41 theory they grant immortality

name: Kalguuran Map Device
summary: Isla's portal-based device by which Atlas Runners map and loot the Atlas while the Exile is away; Sasan the Bandit Lord can hold them hostage.

name: Kishara's Star
summary: Vaal navigational relic found at the Causeway; Weylam wants to give it to Lilly.

name: Kitava's Horns
summary: Two huge black gates in the Ravaged Square that block the way to the Canals and Kitava's Feeding Trough; impenetrable to men, they are broken by the resurrected Innocence.

sources.locator: Bannon: 'two large black gates... Kitava's Horns'

name: Kitava's Torments
summary: Three Karui relics taken by Templars: Hinekora's Hair (whip), Tukohama's Tooth, and Valako's Jaw (fish hook). Lani asks the Exile to recover them in Act 5 for the Karui defence of Ngamakanui. Optional quest (Act 5, 'required: no').

alt_summaries.summary: Three Karui artefacts: Hinekora's Hair, Tukohama's Tooth, Valako's Jaw; kept in the Reliquary.

name: The Lantern of Arimor
summary: Heirloom lantern revealing and rearranging the haunting modifiers of monsters before a zone is entered.

name: Lethal Pride
summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Karui variant. Conquers passives in radius with Karui leadership over warriors under Akoya, Kaom or Rakiata (seed-dependent); adds Strength to small passives. Drops from the Karui legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.

sources.locator: Infobox: base_item = Timeless Jewel; explicit1_text 'Commanded leadership over (10000-18000) warriors under <Akoya • Kaom • Rakiata>'; drop_text 'Karui legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

name: Maligaro's Spike
summary: Maligaro's device that injects calibric extantia into living flesh; stuck in the Weaver's eye as 'Silk's spear'.

name: Map Device
summary: Ancient device of golden instruments that opens portals to the worlds of the Atlas. Per Valdo's Book of Memories it was built by the Watchers of Decay to travel to and lock the Elder's dreamland; Templar expeditions under High Templar Venarius found a broken one in Wraeclast's ruins and Valdo Caeserius (with the Shade's help) assembled it in the Oriath academy. Zana later found another in ruined Oriath; in the legacy epilogue Kirac rebuilt one from parts in the Vault of Venarius; Isla later reimagined it with Kalguuran runes. Different peoples are said to have built their own versions. No source in the corpus ties it to the Precursors.

sources.locator: Memory of Intrigue: 'The intricate golden instruments ... a hundred times more intricate'
Machinist's Vault Aberration quote: 'Different peoples created their own map devices'
lead + Book of Memories Page 9: 'The Watchers, they built the device'
Walkthrough: 'components to rebuild the Map Device' in the Vault of Venarius

name: The Teardrop
summary: Pearl carved with the location of Tsoatha, retrieved from the Reliquary for Lilly.

name: The Maven's Beacon
summary: Map Device upgrade from the first Maven-witnessed boss kill enabling witnessing.

name: Miasmeter
summary: Device sensing the corrupt murmurs of Wraeclast.

name: Militant Faith
summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Templar variant. Conquers passives in radius with new faithful converted by High Templar Avarius, Dominus or Maxarius; adds Devotion to small and notable passives. Drops from the Templar legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.

sources.locator: Infobox: explicit1_text 'Carved to glorify (2000-10000) new faithful converted by High Templar <Avarius • Dominus • Maxarius>'; drop_text 'Templar legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

name: Mirror of Delirium
summary: Mirror found in each area during Delirium league; passing through creates the Delirium fog. Still appears in story maps and league-modifier maps after the league.

name: Mirror of Kalandra
summary: One of the rarest and most valuable currency items in the game, named after Kalandra; the Path of Exile logo resembles it. Kalandra's Touch, a league item, was added to the core drop pool after the league.

alt_summaries.summary: Rarest currency item, named after Kalandra and tied to mirrored items; the PoE logo resembles it.

name: O' Eternal
summary: First-edition book written by the Eternal Empire poet Victario. Victario gave a signed copy to Queen Hyrri of Ngamakanui after the battle against General Lioneye; the book later sat in an Oriathan nobleman's vault (the Vox family), was stolen under Kurai's contract 'Hyrri's Gift' for a client, and became the object of the Negotiation and the Vox vendetta.

sources.locator: 'Hyrri's Gift' and 'The Negotiation' sections; Lore paragraph

name: Primeval Remnant
summary: Currency-like item that opens a portal to the Forge of the Titans; its text recounts the near-extinction of the Titans after the rising darkness (Lightless) of the Winter of the World.

name: Purification Pump
summary: Portable purifying-pumping unit that Sister Cassia places on Blight fungal growths; Blight towers, powered by the fungus's toxic fluid, defend it.

name: Rapture Device
summary: Device Malachai built in the Solaris Temple, claimed able to kill the Beast. Powered by the Eyes of Fury and Desire and Dialla's life force, it tore into the Beast so Malachai could enter.

alt_summaries.summary: Malachai's machine in the Crystal Veins; powered by Eyes and Dialla; drills into the Beast.

name: Recombinator
summary: Isla's prototype that breaks down two matching items and reintegrates them into one new piece.

name: Reverie Device
summary: Malachai's map-using precursor of the Map Device used to enter the Nightmare.

name: Sacred Blossom
summary: Map fragment that opens a portal to The Sacred Grove, where Oshabi, Avatar of the Grove can be encountered. Usable once in a personal Map Device. Drops from tier 4 Harvest bosses (Ersi, Janaar, Namharim); the Heart of the Grove atlas passive stopped always dropping it in 3.19.0.

sources.locator: lead: 'must use a Sacred Blossom in the map device'

name: Templar Relics (Sanctum)
summary: Relics placed on the Sanctum altar to strengthen the Exile across runs; unique relics carry Lycia's written account of Innocence. Aureus is the Templars' coin.

name: Seed of Corruption
summary: Essence found by Sin in a Precursor ruin and used to create the Beast; in PoE2 a seed is stolen by Count Geonor from Sin and grows into a new Beast.

sources.locator: Doryani: 'the instrument of a Second Edict'
Sin found a Precursor ruin containing the Seed of Corruption
Path of Exile 2 section: Sin took the Seed of Corruption into hiding; Geonor binds him and steals it

alt_summaries.summary: A metallic sphere that Count Geonor takes from the Hooded One. It opens and releases corruption across Wraeclast and the Atlas; the PoE2 Exile chases it.
Metallic sphere holding the Seed of Corruption, which Count Geonor took from the Hooded One; it feeds the Beast's growth.
Precursor essence from which Sin grew the Beast; stolen by Count Geonor in Act 1 and carried off by Oriana. Doryani guesses it was the instrument of a Second Edict.

Precursor-made essence from which Sin created the Beast; stolen by Count Geonor at the start of PoE2, then carried by the Countess on the Dreadnought. Doryani speculates it was the instrument of a Second Edict.

name: Sekhema Feather
summary: Symbol of Maraketh leadership; its recipient (Tasuni or Irasha) rules Highgate.

name: Sentinels
summary: Sentinel drones of the Sentinel league (Stalker, Apex and Pandemonium types) that empower monsters. Sentinel Power Cores charge filaments; Recombinators are a separate item. The wiki gives no in-world narrator.

name: Sign of Purity
summary: Weapon forged by Innocence from his own blood, kept in the Templar Ossuary; destroyed by Kitava's beam in Act 5.

sources.locator: Act 5 dialogue: The Sign of Purity
Act 5: beam destroys the Sign of Purity

alt_summaries.summary: Weapon forged from Innocence's blood, gifted to the first High Templar; used by the exile in Act 5-10.
Item from the Ossuary used to fight Kitava; Kitava's beam destroys it.

name: Staff of Avarius
summary: Holy staff of High Templar Avarius lying in the desecrated Chamber of Innocence; Bannon says it can break Kitava's Horns but its real power is to revive Innocence, using Bannon as host.

name: Star of Wraeclast
summary: Necklace with a virtue gem from Kalisa Maas that turned Merveil into a siren.

alt_summaries.summary: Cursed ruby necklace Daresso gave Merveil; it turned her into a monster.

name: Starforge
summary: Sealing blade that bound the Elder's physical form (leaving its spirit, the Shade, free). History of Wraeclast says the Watchers of Decay forged it; scarab flavour text instead credits the Order of the Djinn (Egrin forged it, Qianga delivered it to the Watchers, Betucia bore it to imprison the Elder and sacrificed themselves). Winged Cartography Scarab: 'The Sealing Blade has been removed'.

sources.locator: The Watchers of Decay: 'forge a weapon capable of subduing it - Starforge'

name: The Storm Blade
summary: Crystal sword of Garukhan capturing storms; its storm is bottled to disperse Shakari's sandstorm.

name: The Apex
summary: Capstone formed by combining the three bandit amulets, used on the Dark Altar to summon the Vaal Oversoul and lift the darkness.

name: The Sovereign
summary: Ship built in an underground pit-laboratory by masked men working for the Templars using a tortured prisoner, Vesper, as its heart; fuelled by Dead Man's Sulphur and the Allflame.

name: Timeless Jewel
summary: Jewels introduced in Legion league (3.7.0) that rewrite nearby passives by legion faction; variants include Glorious Vanity (Vaal: Doryani/Xibaqua/Ahuatotli) and Elegant Hubris (Eternal: Cadiro/Victario/Caspiro). Other jewels (Lethal Pride, Brutal Restraint, Militant Faith) exist but their figure lists were not verified.

name: Tolman's Bracelet
summary: Bracelet Clarissa made for Tolman.

name: Tower Key
summary: Royal key dropped by Piety allowing entry to the Sceptre of God.

name: Transmutia Device
summary: Device given by Malachai to Maligaro to manipulate virtue gems; later the exile's crafting bench.

name: Triskelion Flame
summary: Rune-forged Kalguuran relic honouring Aldur; made a symbol of royal authority under Cadigan I; carried on the first Wraeclast expedition to purify poisoned rain/fish and raise a starlight barrier; stolen by Olroth and later destroyed in the exile's fight with him.

alt_summaries.summary: Sacred flame whose starlight barrier protected the Kalguuran colony; destroyed by the Exile in the Olroth fight.

Kalguuran relic forged by the Runefathers in honour of Aldur; purifies corrupted food and projects a starlight barrier. Stolen by Olroth, who used it to keep himself alive; destroyed in the encounter with Dannig and the Exile.

name: Voidstones
summary: Atlas upgrades unlocked by defeating pinnacle bosses and talking to Kirac: Decayed (Elder), Ceremonial (Maven), Omniscient/Grasping (Searing Exarch / Eater quests, 3.17), Originator Voidstone (Incarnation of Dread). In 3.28.0 the Exarch and Eater together give one Voidstone and the Incarnation of Dread gives the extra one.

name: Watchstones
summary: Crystallised memories of the Elder's past victims, expelled when it was defeated by the Cosmic Arcana; Baran left one behind (Zana dialogue). As game items, Watchstones were socketed into Citadels in the legacy 3.9-3.16 Atlas. Their relation to Voidstones is not stated in the corpus.

name: Wings of Vastiri
summary: Highest symbol of office of the Maraketh Sekhema of Sekhemas, last worn by Asenath before Hector Titucius murdered her; recovered from Hector in the Bath House for Hargan, who plans to sell it back to the Maraketh.

alt_summaries.summary: Maraketh symbol of office taken by Titucius, retrieved from his undead remains in Act 4.

name: Abaxoth, the End of All That Is
summary: Unique Beyond demon that dual-wields two Edges of Madness and uses Ice Spear with Greater Multiple Projectiles, Vaal Storm Call and Summon Skeletons; it was introduced in 1.2.0 with the Beyond demons and removed in 3.19.0, when Beyond demons were replaced by Scourge monsters.

sources.locator: Intro: 'is a unique Beyond Demon'; header '3.19.0 replaced the original Beyond demons with monsters from Scourge'; Version history 1.2.0 'Introduced' / 3.19.0 'Removed from the game'
infobox and lead; Version History (1.2.0 introduced, 3.19.0 removed)
lead: 'Rampage league ... ran concurrently with Beyond league' (1.2.0)

alt_summaries.summary: Unique Beyond demon, seen dual-wielding two Edges of Madness, with Berserk Fury and a Chaos damage-over-time aura. The wiki states that 3.19.0 replaced the original Beyond demons with Scourge monsters and removed Abaxoth.

name: Adiyah, the Wayfinder
summary: Maraketh warrior and Wayfinder of the Rogue Harbour who opens Heist and Grand Heist portals for the exile. Her sister Nashta the Usurper tried to incite a civil war in the Maraketh; Adiyah and the exile stop her in the questline's final contract.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: "Open portal to the contract zone by interacting with Adiyah"

name: Administrator Qotra
summary: Figure named on flavour text of replica uniques and as a Heist contract client; Kalandra says she 'meddles with forces she does not understand'. Item Qotra's Regulator (Ritual league) may refer to her.

name: Admiral Valerius
summary: Pirate boss fought in Sailor's Folly when a shipment is commandeered; can drop Admiral's Arrogance.

name: General Adus
summary: Commander of Highgate who joined Voll; sheltered in Highgate Refinery; killed in Act 9.

name: Ahkeli, the Clayshaper
summary: Descendant of the primeval civilisation, 'Honoured Founder' of the Order of the Djinn who, with the surviving Maraketh, repelled Lightless invasions during the Winter of the World; central figure of late primeval history (Ahkeli's rings).

sources.locator: Primeval civilization: Ahkeli; The Order of the Djinn

alt_summaries.summary: Primeval survivor whose home and family were destroyed, who sought refuge in the ash clouds and joined a Maraketh akhara to found the Order of the Djinn and defeat the Lightless; died before Solerai and Lundara ended the Winter.
Honoured founder of the Order of the Djinn, descendant of the primeval civilization that protected the Maraketh; per Kalandra took refuge at the Lake for a time.

name: Ahuana
summary: Chieftain of the Ramako tribe who believes Ramako was impersonated by a deceiver; her text covers the Cataclysm as experienced in Ngamakanui.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

alt_summaries.summary: Minimal node: Karui chieftain, daughter of Hyrri Ngamaku who succeeded her as ruler; encountered in the Halls of the Dead.

name: Ahuatotli, the Blind
summary: Vaal figure fought as a Delve boss in the Vaal Nexus (Grand Architect's Temple); also a Timeless Jewel (Glorious Vanity) name.

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal-themed Delve boss in The Grand Architect's Temple.

name: Ailith, First of the Keepers
summary: Founder/leader of the Keepers of the Flame (Order of the Purple Flame) in the Monastery; in PoE1 3.27/3.28 she enlists the Exile against the Hiveborn at the Coast (Act 6), gives the Exile the flame to burn Hiveborn barriers and destroys Fortified Breaches. Author of The Word of the Dreamer. Revealed (Keepers league) to have died long ago: the Dreamer preserved her essence and keeps copies of her, burning and replacing her when she learns this. Also in PoE2.

sources.locator: Talk to Ailith; summon Ailith to destroy Fortified Breach
written by Ailith, First of the Keepers
Dialogue "Enter Back Room": "you died, long ago. I preserved your essence."
Lore: Ailith founded the Order after visions; clone/preserved essence
Lore: Ailith founded the Order; she is a copy the Dreamer keeps; PoE2 version aware of her nature
Sky Hives: defend Ailith while she closes the domain

alt_summaries.summary: Leader of the Keepers; tends the Genesis Tree at the Monastery, receives dream warnings, and guides the Exile to graft Breach flesh onto themselves.

Founder of the Order of the Purple Flame / Keepers of the Flame after visions of the Dreamer (PoE1 Keepers); in PoE2 0.5 she leads the Breach questline against the Hiveborn, defends the Sky Hive domain closure and is a preserved essence/copy kept by the Dreamer, who has become somewhat self-aware. 'Alith' is a guide misspelling.

name: Aisling Laffrey
summary: Syndicate member without established background. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Akoya
summary: Chieftain of the Tukohama tribe, resident of the Halls of the Dead and an opponent in the Trial of the Ancestors.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

name: Al-Hezmin, the Hunter
summary: Competitive hunter elderslayer of Redblade clan origin who keeps a journal of rivalries and plots to kill Drox.

name: Alano Phrecia
summary: General who defeated the dark being in 35 IC, sealed it away and was crowned Emperor, founding the Phrecian line.

name: Aldur
summary: First King of Kalguur and first Runefather, inventor of runesmithing (Verisium runes capturing starlight); his Runefathers forged the Triskelion Flame after his death.

alt_summaries.summary: First Runefather and first king of Kalguur; by legend crafted the first runes.

name: Alira
summary: Bandit lord of the Western Forest who uses corpse-detonation magic (Detonate Dead) and a cauldron; wears Alira's Amulet, one of three pieces of the Apex.

name: Alva Valai
summary: Treasure hunter and archaeologist of Vaal descent; PoE1 Incursion Master who creates temporal incursions into Atzoatl; PoE2 Act 3 companion at the Ziggurat Encampment whose Vaal blood activates the time gateway.

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal-descended treasure hunter who guides the Exile through Utzaal, activates the time gateway and is rescued from Doryani.
PoE1 (Incursion) explorer who travels with the Exile and the Hooded One to Kingsmarch, goes ahead to her contact Rog in Kingsmarch and then departs to study a tome. Continuity link to PoE1.

name: Amanamu, Liege of the Lightless
summary: Abyssal Lich, commander of the Lightless and servant of Kulemak. Boss of the Abyssal Depths (Abyss league 3.1.0).

sources.locator: Lich Lords who serve under Kulemak - Amanamu, Kurgal, and Ulaman

alt_summaries.summary: Amanamu is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.
Lich Lord under Kulemak; boss of the Abyssal Depths.

name: High Templar Andronicus
summary: High Templar backing Tyndarus Phrecius c. 870 IC.

name: Archbishop Geofri the Abashed
summary: Archbishop Geofri the Abashed, a supporter of Voll's Purity Rebellion; boss of the Crypt (Fellshrine) tied to the Golden Hand of Through Sacred Ground.

name: Sekhema Asala
summary: Sekhema of the Ardura akhara; leads the Maraketh against the Faridun and executes Jamanra the Abomination.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Consult with Asala' / 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination'

alt_summaries.summary: Ardura Sekhema in PoE2 who opens the Halani Gates and kills Jamanra, accepting Faridun warriors.
Maraketh Sekhema of the Ardura who unifies the akharas for war; officiates the Gifting of Water at Qimah.

name: Sekhema Asenath
summary: Maraketh Sekhema of Sekhemas ('the Golden Sekhema') who last wore the Wings of Vastiri and was murdered by Hector Titucius.

sources.locator: Hargan: last worn by Sekhema Asenath, the Golden Sekhema

name: Atalui, Vaal Priestess
summary: Vaal priestess mentioned only in flavour text of Bloodseeker (not to be confused with PoE2's Atalui).

name: Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
summary: Last Queen of the Vaal: vain, narcissistic ruler obsessed with eternal youth and beauty who demanded ever more sacrifice. Her pursuit of immortality with Doryani led to the Vaal Cataclysm; she ended trapped in a crimson nightmare realm. Boss in PoE1 (Apex of Sacrifice, Alluring Abyss/Uber, Throne of Atziri) and pinnacle boss (Atziri, the Red Queen) of PoE2's Fate of the Vaal.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Capture Doryani' (quote 'Atziri will soon commune with the Beast')

alt_summaries.summary: Queen of the Vaal, whose planned communion with the Beast in Utzaal's past led to the Vaal Cataclysm.
Name for Atziri when fought in the Alluring Abyss (assembled from the four Mortal fragments): mechanically the same boss as at the Apex of Sacrifice but with area modifiers that make it far harder.

name: Aukuna, the Black Sekhema
summary: Sekhema (leader) of the Maraketh; general of the Maraketh legion.

name: Aul, the Crystal King
summary: Slave who led an uprising against Putembo, became Ahn and a tyrant, bargained with Kulemak, and as possessed golems destroyed his realm enacted a final ritual encasing his citadel in azurite crystal. Delve boss.

alt_summaries.summary: Also Ahn; former slave who led an uprising and became the last king of the primeval civilisation; deceived by Kulemak (golem for power), which ended his civilisation; he sealed himself and his citadel in azurite crystal. Delve boss at depth 130+.

name: High Templar Avarius
summary: High Templar who ordered the Templar Courts and Chamber of Innocence built shortly before PoE1. In Act 5 the Exile defeats him in the Templar Courts; he then becomes a vessel for Innocence.

sources.locator: section 'Lore' (exile enters the Templar Courts and defeats High Templar Avarius in Act 5)
Staff of Avarius in the Chamber of Innocence

alt_summaries.summary: Replaced Dominus in Oriath; vessel of Innocence; built the Templar Courts; killed by exile Act 5.
Dominus's successor as High Templar, secret vessel of the god Innocence; Act 5 boss in the Chamber of Innocence.
High Templar who served as Innocence's vessel in Act 5; his Staff of Purity is recovered in Act 10 to break Kitava's Horns and revive Innocence in a new host.

name: Bannon
summary: Former Oriath soldier who asks the Exile to stop Utula; vendor after Avarius.

sources.locator: quest Death and Rebirth: Bannon used the Staff of Purity and sacrificed himself to resurrect Innocence
Bannon: 'I will become his host in the fullest sense'

alt_summaries.summary: Templar commander and Act 10 ally who uses the Staff of Purity to resurrect Innocence, sacrificing himself; Lani says he went to Hinekora's home. Minimal node (owned by campaign domain).

Act 5 vendor and ally of Lani who bears the fire of Ngamahu; rescued by the exile on the Cathedral Rooftop in Act 10, he uses the Staff of Avarius and sacrifices himself to become the host of the resurrected Innocence.

name: Baran, the Crusader
summary: Templar elderslayer who hears 'God's whispers', blames Zana for sealing the device and plans an Atlas nation; brother of Kirac. Kirac says the Maven resurrects him to watch his fights with the Exile.

name: Beidat
summary: Leader of the 'pale demons', one of the three Scourge factions; unlike the headless-drone demon and flesh factions he can speak and bargain with humans, and gave Lycia immortality.

alt_summaries.summary: Scourge boss (Archangel of Death) that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats and no individual lore.

name: Bestel
summary: Lioneye's Watch merchant and amateur poet who asks the exile to kill Abberath.

alt_summaries.summary: Sailor-poet at Lioneye's Watch whose ship the Merry Gull ran aground; his epic and rewards follow Act 1 quests (also Act 6).

name: Betucia
summary: Named on a Gilded Cartography Scarab as 'Bearer of the Sealing Blade' who sacrificed themselves to imprison the Elder; the Order of the Djinn 'will be forever wounded by your loss'.

name: The Black Star
summary: Champion of the Cleansing Fire met in the Polaric Void; precedes the Exarch.

name: Brutus, Lord Incarcerator
summary: Legendary warden of Axiom Prison who had himself transformed by thaumaturges (Shavronne of Umbra) into a hulking monster; killed in The Caged Brute.

alt_summaries.summary: Warden of Axiom Prison; his transformation by Shavronne drove him mad; Act 1 boss.

name: King Cadigan the First
summary: Kalguuran king under whom the Triskelion Flame was a symbol of authority; the Flame had earlier been taken by a self-proclaimed descendant of Aldur who had challengers killed.

name: Cadiro Perandus
summary: Perandus family member and uncle of Emperor Chitus Perandus, who used his wealth to rig the Lord's Labyrinth in Chitus's favour. NPC of Perandus league (2.2.0) selling items for Perandus Coins from caches he hid after the Cataclysm; later available as Syndicate Research-safehouse/hideout NPC; named on the Elegant Hubris timeless jewel.

sources.locator: lead: Cadiro hid the family treasures in secret caches

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus' uncle, patron of Prospero; engineered Perandus' win, surrendered Sarn to Voll, and hid the treasury, binding debtors in undeath to guard it.

name: Cameria the Coldblooded
summary: Assassin/murderer Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Captain Arteri
summary: Boss on the Western Forest road carrying the Thaumetic Emblem for the Thaumetic Seal.

name: Captain Fairgraves
summary: Marooned sea captain in the Ship Graveyard who found the Allflame, tried to kindle it with the Exile's life and was killed; reappears as an in-between spirit at the Act 3 Docks.

name: The Cardinal of Fear
summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Fear; Eagon siphons its kernel.

name: Caspiro
summary: Second Emperor, a low-born legionnaire who survived a labyrinth trial; dismembered by a dark being five years after Veruso's death.

name: Catarina, Master of Undeath
summary: Necromancer forsaken master who became leader of the Immortal Syndicate (the Mastermind); wanted to become eternal queen; killed the Order of the Djinn for the Horns of Kulamac; boss in Mastermind's Lair. Writer of the Lifegiver's Manifesto.

name: Cavas
summary: Amnesiac 'forgotten spirit' NPC of Synthesis who opens memory zones for the exile; he recovers his memories in the Atlas and is revealed to be High Templar Venarius, thereafter an antagonist while Zana takes over his guide role.

alt_summaries.summary: Memoryless spirit/old man in Synthesis who seeks his lost memories in the Memory Nexus; fragments suggest a beach childhood. Exact identity not resolved in sources read.

name: Chiara
summary: Wife of Veruso; died in childbirth; Ankh ritual reportedly made her a monster.

name: Chitus Perandus
summary: Perandus who rigged the Lord's Labyrinth, poisoned the Ezomyte slave Weylin, and became Emperor in 1319 IC. Brutal, vain, ruled with Malachai's gemling thaumatocracy; killed by Ondar at the Night of a Thousand Ribbons in 1334 IC.

sources.locator: section 'Reign of Chitus' and 'The Lord's Labyrinth'

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus Perandus, crowned Emperor in 1319 IC. He wins the Lord's Labyrinth by betraying Weylin, then seals Izaro inside it. Overthrown by the Purity Rebellion.
Minimal node: Eternal Empire emperor of the Perandus family, nephew of Cadiro; assassinated during the Purity Rebellion by Ondar. Full entry owned by the Eternal Empire domain.
Emperor of the Eternal Empire.

name: Clarissa
summary: Exile woman rescued from Blackguards in Sarn; becomes Sarn Encampment accessory vendor; lover of Tolman.

alt_summaries.summary: Sarn survivor (captured with Tolman in Act 3, she escaped) who in Act 8 tries to revive her dead lover Tolman with the Ankh of Eternity; the ritual fails, and she resolves to destroy the Ankh.

name: Duelist (Exile class)
summary: Exile class. Dominus: "Welcome to the greatest of arenas, Duelist. God is watching."; Gravicius: "Your soul was lost long ago!" Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

name: Marauder (Exile class)
summary: Karui-descended Exile class. Dominus's boss line to the Marauder: "I exiled an animal. Now you almost resemble a man, Karui."; General Gravicius: "You've forgotten your place, Karui slave!" Specific crime not given in the sources read.

name: Ranger (Exile class)
summary: Exile class (female). Dominus: "It is woman's purpose to tempt and try the will of man."; Gravicius: "little girl". Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

name: Scion (Exile class)
summary: Seventh Exile class, available only after reaching Act 3 (unlock details not re-verified). Dominus: "I offered you the gift of exile and you used it to reinvent yourself." No further heritage lore verified.

name: Shadow (Exile class)
summary: Exile class. Dominus: "I've dealt with far darker shadows than you, exile."; Gravicius: "You're not the only one who wields death as a weapon, boy!" Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

name: Templar (Exile class)
summary: Exile class belonging to the Templar faith: Dominus addresses the Templar as "my brother" ("Exile has tested you, my brother"); Gravicius: "You're god's greatest disappointment." Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

sources.locator: intro: 'The character class Templar is a former member of the Order prior to his exile before the start of Act 1'

alt_summaries.summary: The Templar class: a former member of the Order of the Templar who was exiled before the start of Act 1 and is a playable PoE1 class. The Exile's backstory as a Templar is given by the wiki only for this class.

name: Witch (Exile class)
summary: Exile class. Dominus: "You'd bite the master that called you here, Witch?"; Gravicius: "whore of nightmare"; Piety addresses the Witch as 'sister' in Act 4. A developer-interview reason for the Witch's exile (PC Gamer) could NOT be re-verified in this check and has been removed.

name: The Cortex
summary: Synthesis memory boss in a Distant Memory in the Nexus (arena forms listed as Fractal Gargantuan, Synthete Masterpiece, Fractal Titan, Synthete Nightmare).

name: Dannig, Warrior Skald
summary: Kalguuran blacksmith and Warrior Skald whose goal is to recover the Triskelion Flame; runesmith, game-night friend of Rog, Tujen and Gwennen; in PoE2 manages Verisium/Runeforging in Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: Act 4 quest: bring Torn Map Pieces to Dannig

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran blacksmith and skald; Expedition NPC who starts The Lost Expedition quest (Act 6). He asks the exile to keep the Flame's fate from the settlers. In PoE2 he crafts Verisium Spikes at Kingsmarch.
Kalguuran warrior skald and smith in Kingsmarch who forges the Verisium Spikes freeing Freya Hartlin and later runes; sings tales the Karui like.
Kalguuran NPC met in Act 4 (The Runeseeker brings Torn Map Pieces to him) and at the Ruins of Kingsmarch in The Grand Expedition.

name: Daresso
summary: King of Swords of Theopolis' Grand Arena; left Oriath c. 1450 IC to cure Merveil; spirit used by Malachai; defeated in Act 4. Chronology caveat: the wiki dates his departure c. 1450 IC yet says his spirit was already used by Malachai (Eye of Desire, 1336 IC) and had been dead ~100 years; the wiki itself calls this 'inexplicable'.

alt_summaries.summary: Former slave gladiator and Sword King of the Grand Arena of Theopolis/Sarn, husband of Merveil; he abandoned her and sailed from Wraeclast seeking a cure, and later perished; boss of Daresso's Dream / Grand Arena in Act 4 who holds the Eye of Desire.

curation: codex: left Oriath c. 1450 IC, after the 1339 IC Cataclysm

name: Davaro of Theopolis
summary: Templar thaumaturge who heard Vaal relics 'sing', saw visions of Atziri and sacrificed Karui slaves and Oriathan children to her altar.

name: Dawn
summary: Insane exile who calls himself 'The Dawn', devotee of Solaris who guards the Sun Orb in the Solaris Temple as the boss Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris.

sources.locator: Lore: once an exile, became insane and a devotee of Solaris

alt_summaries.summary: Act 8 unique boss in the Solaris Temple Level 2 (quest Solar Eclipse). Per Maramoa 'the Dawn' was an exile who went insane and became a devotee of Solaris. Despite the title 'Harbinger' he is unrelated to Harbinger league.

name: The Deceitful God
summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Dread; Eagon siphons its kernel.

name: The Depraved Trinity
summary: Combined spirit of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre, manifested by Sin in the Rotting Core; final boss of Act 9.

name: Sekhema Deshret
summary: Ancient Maraketh Red Sekhema who sealed the Mines with the Beast and Kaom inside; fell to Voll, and her spirit was trapped in the Mines until freed.

alt_summaries.summary: Red Sekhema who destroyed Titucius' legion, sealed the Highgate mines, and was killed by Voll; spirit rescued in Act 9.

name: Dhunan
summary: Historical Order of the Djinn member, 'Blightmaster', a castaway who knew how to contain the Blight and theorised the Blightheart.

name: Lady Dialla
summary: Malachai's concubine and promised Gemling Queen; jewels set along her spine. Refused to sacrifice herself in the Rapture Device and survived centuries. Met in Act 3.

alt_summaries.summary: The Gemling Queen, Malachai's former lover and the Rapture Device's intended power source who chose not to sacrifice herself; guides the Exile in Acts 3-4.

name: Divinia
summary: Templar archivist and relic enthusiast met at the Oriath Docks in Act 10 (quest 'Aiding an Archivist'); she sends the Exile for the Mortinomicon Exitio Immortalis and later sells relics inside the Sanctum. She knows far more about Lycia and the Scourge than she lets on; her true motives are left ambiguous.

sources.locator: 'Talk to Divinia in Oriath Docks'; Mortinomicon dialogue
[1:24]-[1:50], [12:24]-[13:20], [36:38]-[37:15] (video places her meeting in Act 2 camp; wiki says Oriath Docks Act 10)

alt_summaries.summary: Templar archivist at the Oriath docks who seeks the Mortinomicon.

name: Doedre
summary: Doedre Darktongue (Stamatis), curse-obsessed pupil of Maligaro/member of the Godless Three; burned by Voll; revived by Malachai; fought in Act 4 (Harvest), Act 8 (Doedre's Cesspool) and Act 9 (Rotting Core).

sources.locator: 'until the player character defeats her in Act 8'; 'In-game encounters'

alt_summaries.summary: Thaumaturge of the Godless Three burned at the stake by Voll; Act 4 boss in the Harvest, drops Malachai's Lungs.
Third of Malachai's Godless Three; her undead spirit lurks in the Sarn sewers and is killed in Act 8.

name: Dominus
summary: High Templar in PoE1's era who exiled criminals to Wraeclast; killed by the exile atop the Sceptre of God in Act 3.

sources.locator: section 'Lore' (Dominus exiles criminals; killed atop the Sceptre of God in Act 3)

alt_summaries.summary: High Templar who orders criminals of Oriath exiled to Wraeclast, including the Exile. The Exile kills him atop the Sceptre of God in Act 3.
Highest-ranking High Templar of Oriath, controls Ebony Legion; pardoned Piety; final boss of Act 3 in the Sceptre of God; Ascendant form with blood magic.
Successor of Venarius as High Templar and exiler of the PoE1 protagonist.
Templar who brought Vaal relics to Oriath.

name: Doryani
summary: Vaal Royal Thaumaturgist to Queen Atziri (PoE1 wiki: Queen's Thaumaturgist); in PoE2 he is captured in Utzaal's past, agrees to help contain the Beast, and joins the present-day effort with a weapon fragment.

sources.locator: Quest logs 'Capture Doryani' / 'Speak to Doryani in Ziggurat Encampment'
The Dark Ember: 'ancient wound wrought by that Vaalish overreacher, Doryani'

alt_summaries.summary: Minimal node (owned by Vaal domain): Vaal thaumaturgist under Atziri whose innovations and sacrifices contributed to the Fall of the Vaal; also appears in PoE2; named on Glorious Vanity.
Vaal Royal Thaumaturge (PoE1) companion of the PoE2 Exile: drives the Weapon search, prepares contingency Vaal reserves and in the endgame builds the Waygate.

Atziri's Royal Thaumaturge ('Queen's Thaumaturgist'), the most capable and ruthless mind of her court, whose gem, technology and Beast experiments brought the Vaal prosperity and, per PoE1, ruined them; Sin calls him a 'Vaalish overreacher' who wounded the Beast. PoE2 reframes the Cataclysm as Atziri's doing: Doryani secretly opposed her communion, was captured by the Exile in Act 3 (Utzaal's past) and brought to the present as an ally seeking to contain the Beast. Claims that he built 2,000-year contingencies come only from fan analysis.

name: Drox, the Warlord
summary: Warrior elderslayer who strives to found a just kingdom in the Atlas through force.

name: Dusk
summary: Insane exile ('exile-turned-sycophant', in Maramoa's words) who devotes himself to Lunaris and guards the Moon Orb in the Lunaris Temple as the boss Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris.

sources.locator: Lore: according to Maramoa, "The Dusk" is an exile-turned-sycophant

alt_summaries.summary: Act 8 unique boss in the Lunaris Temple Level 2 (quest Lunar Eclipse). Per Maramoa 'the Dusk' is an exile-turned-sycophant who carried the Moon Orb into the Lunaris Temple. Unrelated to Harbinger league.

name: Dying Exile
summary: Wounded fellow exile on the beach who points the player toward smoke at ruins.

name: Eagon Caeserius
summary: Scholar and Atlas researcher who claims Zana as his sister and Valdo as father; chases the Originator's memory threads with the exile via Memory Tears and Astrolabes. Hints that his parentage is uncertain ('If I am not Valdo's bastard...'); his identity is a community mystery.

sources.locator: Speak to Eagon quest log; Memory Vault dialogue
dev commentary: Eagon's situation remains complicated

alt_summaries.summary: Caeserius family member who recruits the Exile to follow Memory Threads to the Originator.

name: Eber, the Plaguemaw
summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0; the wiki marks the Pale Council fight as removed from the game in 3.17.0.

sources.locator: Infobox: location = The Pale Court; header 'The prophecy system was removed ... in version 3.17.0. The Pale Council fight no longer exists'; Version history 2.3.0 'Introduced to the game'

name: Egrin
summary: Young Azmeri whose visions may have led the descent; later cast out and taken in by the Order of the Djinn.

name: Einhar Frey
summary: Master-NPC beastmaster who teaches the Exile to capture beasts and runs the Menagerie; appears in Act 2 (Forest Encampment, Einhar's Hunt).

name: The Elder
summary: Entity of malignant madness and servant of the Decay that preyed on children, feeding on their nightmares and later on Valdo's memories. Released by Venarius, it hunted the Atlas until the exile and Zana expelled it with the Cosmic Arcana; a memory of it remains as a pinnacle boss (Uber Elder).

alt_summaries.summary: Harder memory-version of the Elder met in the Shaper's Realm; Elder is a memory defeated 'with aid of a certain rogue cartographer' (Zana).

name: Elder Guardian: Constrictor
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Constriction, part of the Key to Decay.

sources.locator: The Elder section: Fragment of Constriction

name: Elder Guardian: Enslaver
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Enslavement, part of the Key to Decay.

sources.locator: The Elder section: Fragment of Enslavement

name: Elder Guardian: Eradicator
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Eradication, part of the Key to Decay.

sources.locator: The Elder section: Fragment of Eradication

name: Elder Guardian: Purifier
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Purification, part of the Key to Decay.

sources.locator: The Elder section: Fragment of Purification

name: Elreon, Loremaster
summary: Exiled Templar who believed thaumaturgy a divine gift; forsaken master (jewellery). Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: The Empty-Eyed Fiend
summary: Entity Olroth could not defeat with blade or flame, prompting him to use gems; the Kalguur page links it to The Elder (identification inferred).

alt_summaries.summary: Horror Olroth could not harm with mortal blade or flame until a gem's starlight beheaded it.

name: The Envoy
summary: Messenger NPC met in T6+ maps who introduces the Maven and the Eldritch Horrors, speaking of the Struggle over the Atlas; speaks of Cleansing Fire's blindness to 'the lightkeeper'. Also gives the Flesh Compass and Luminous Astrolabe that let the Exile hunt the Tangle's and Cleansing Fire's footholds.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Envoy gives Flesh Compass / Luminous Astrolabe

name: Eramir
summary: Scholar from Theopolis (he looked after its museum) living at the Bridge Encampment; he translates the Vaal inscriptions on the relic that washed ashore, identifies the god Ralakesh and asks the exile to end Greust's possession. He fears another theocratic dictatorship.

sources.locator: Valdo: 'until Eramir sent in ancient parchments'

alt_summaries.summary: Scholar-like resident of the Forest Encampment who holds theories on the Vaal ruin and Apex; starts Deal with the Bandits.
Scholar who sent Valdo the ancient parchments on the Watchers of Decay.

name: Evilandra
summary: Hostile 'evil' reflection of Kalandra (ArbiterWildEvil in game files). She rarely appears in the Lake and has her own tile dialogue.

alt_summaries.summary: Rare hostile reflection of Kalandra in the Lake (game id ArbiterWildEvil) with glowing red eyes who duplicates map bosses.

name: The Exile (PoE1)
summary: The player's character in PoE1: a convict sentenced to Wraeclast by High Templar Dominus in 1599-1600 IC. The character washes up on the Twilight Strand, escapes a Templar boat, and fights through Acts 1-10 (defeating Dominus in Act 3, Voll's remains in Act 4, High Templar Avarius and Innocence in Act 5, and Kitava in Act 10 with Sin) and the Atlas storylines.

sources.locator: section 'Lore' (exile escapes Templar boat; defeats Dominus, Avarius, Kitava)

alt_summaries.summary: The PoE1 protagonist, one of seven classes.
The PoE1 protagonist.

name: Faustus, the Financier
summary: Former Heist captain turned Kingsmarch financier running the Currency Exchange, respec and Black Market; writes of waiting and watching the King; reported dead in PoE2 ('rest his soul').

alt_summaries.summary: Rogue Harbour fence who buys Heist targets in exchange for Rogue's Markers. The Kalguur page says Faustus, like Johan, has his sights set on Wraeclast.

name: Fidelitas, the Mourning
summary: Former slave Raulo, Maligaro's loyal lover/servant, deformed into a monster that guards the Baleful Gem.

name: Gaius Sentari
summary: Ezomyte slavemaster and governor beaten at Glarryn; ran Highgate 'civilization camps'.

name: General Gravicius
summary: Dominus's assistant in artifact gathering, Ebony Barracks boss; fire-damage specialist.

name: Archbishop Geofri
summary: Archbishop of Phrecia Cathedral killed by Maligaro; undead guardian in Act 2.

name: Ghorr, the Grasping Maw
summary: Scourge boss that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats and no individual lore.

name: Gianna
summary: Deception rogue (the Master of Disguise). Backstory: she worked at the Theopolis Thespian Society in Oriath, and her early contracts involve Templar uniforms. Unlocked by a Vinderi contract.

sources.locator: Lead and Lore: Theopolis Thespian Society; "To unlock Gianna, run a contract with Vinderi"

name: Gravicius Reborn
summary: Former Act 3 general, resurrected Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Greust
summary: Azmeri-friendly villager of the Forest Encampment (his shrine and necklace follow Azmeri custom) who becomes the avatar of Ralakesh through a washed-up Vaal relic in Act 7; the exile must kill him to force Ralakesh back into the relic. Helena asks that his necklace be laid at the Azmeri shrine in the Northern Forest.

alt_summaries.summary: Forest Encampment weapon/armour vendor and hunter, hostile to Oriathans; gives Intruders in Black. (Helena calls the village Azmeri; Greust's own ethnicity is not stated in the sources read.)

name: Grigor
summary: Poet-scholar of the Sarn Encampment who knows the ode 'Of Jewels and Eternity', sends the Exile to the Gemling Queen, then after Piety and Dominus; Maramoa says to 'look upon Grigor to see what life entails under Piety's influence'.

name: Guardian of the Void: Chimera
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Chimera, part of the Key to the Crucible.

sources.locator: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Chimera'

name: Guardian of the Void: Hydra
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Hydra, part of the Key to the Crucible.

sources.locator: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Hydra'

name: Guardian of the Void: Minotaur
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Minotaur, part of the Key to the Crucible.

sources.locator: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Minotaur'

name: Guardian of the Void: Phoenix
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Phoenix, part of the Key to the Crucible.

sources.locator: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Phoenix'

name: Guff "Tiny" Grenn
summary: Syndicate member from the Brinerot warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Gwennen, the Gambler
summary: Kalguuran gambler and former rebel who avoids Kingsmarch because Johan, scarred by her, could recognise her and expose surviving rebels.

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran gambler and Expedition NPC who sells unidentified equipment and takes Broken Circle artifacts.
Kalguuran missing in the islands; rescued in The Grand Expedition; wife of Rog per 0.5.

name: Hailrake
summary: Boss of the Tidal Island holding Doctor Opden's Medicine Chest.

name: Haku, Armourmaster
summary: Karui forsaken master (armour); Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Hargan
summary: Sarn Encampment weapon/armour vendor; fence who seeks Victario's busts for his 'return to Oriath' fund.

alt_summaries.summary: Sarn Encampment trader who points out Doedre and sends the exile after the Wings of Vastiri.

name: Hector Titucius, Eternal Servant
summary: One of the Undying: murderer of the Maraketh Sekhema Asenath (the Golden Sekhema), who again guards her Wings of Vastiri in the Bath House; Hargan wants the Wings to ransom back to the Maraketh.

alt_summaries.summary: Ezomyte-born gemling general, 'Scourge of the Maraketh', destroyed by Deshret's storm trap in 1333 IC.

name: Helena
summary: Young Oriathan Ebony Legion woman rescued from the Chamber of Sins; joins the Forest Encampment and directs the Lorrata plan.

alt_summaries.summary: Former Piety expedition member at the Bridge Encampment; tells of Maligaro's secret passage and Greust's memorial.

name: Hillock, the Blacksmith
summary: Act 1 boss Hillock resurrected by the Mastermind and joined the Syndicate. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

alt_summaries.summary: First boss of Act 1 (Twilight Strand); exiled criminal turned zombie; later resurrected as Hillock, the Blacksmith of the Syndicate.
First boss: an undead exile (Hillock of Slaugh) with a sword in his chest guarding the end of the Twilight Strand; killed in Enemy at the Gate.

name: Huck
summary: Former soldier who joined the Ring after his discharge and hunts a lost friend, Enoch, who died in Templar research on augmentations. Hireable in Heists; unlocked by a Karst contract, and his contract unlocks Niles.

sources.locator: Lead; Personal Questline; "To unlock Huck, run a contract with Karst" (Niles page); "Took it out not long after joining the Ring"

name: Queen Hyrri Ngamaku
summary: Kaom's niece, archer, led Karui archers at Lioneye's Watch and the Karui at the Grain Gate; after Kaom's death guided the remaining 500 Karui families home, became queen, had a child with Victario (per wiki) and was succeeded by her daughter Ahuana; later vanished.

sources.locator: Lore: 'She later became the queen and had a child with Victario ... succeeded by her daughter, Ahuana'

alt_summaries.summary: Niece of King Kaom; trained in archery at Thebrus and led Karui women archers in the ambush that defeated Marceus Lioneye at Lioneye's Watch (Purity Rebellion). After Kaom's corruption she led 500 Karui families home to Ngamakanui, became queen, had a child with Victario, then vanished leading an army against an unknown threat; succeeded by Ahuana. General of the Karui legion in Legion league (3.7.0).
Kaom's niece; led the bow-women whose arrows surprised Lioneye and succeeded Kaom as Karui queen after he left.

name: Icius Perandus
summary: Eternal Empire-era scholar and translator of Vaalish texts (name suggests the Perandus family, not verified); hid four Golden Pages in the Sarn Archives; friend of Siosa; also cited as author of the 'Chronicle of Atzoatl'.

alt_summaries.summary: Scholar to the Empire, translated Vaal artefacts for Malachai, hid the Golden Pages, joined the Order of the Djinn.

name: Ikiaho
summary: Chieftain of the Arohongui tribe, loyal to Arohongui; vouched for Rakiata in the Halls of the Dead and tells that Ramako was impersonated.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

name: Incarnation of Dread
summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Reverence: Valdo's promise of a brighter future.

name: Incarnation of Fear
summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Trauma: Valdo's fury at Zana.

name: Incarnation of Neglect
summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Loneliness: Zana asks Valdo to admire the Atlas; 'Not now, Zana!'. Interpretive: its Valdo/Zana 'Not now, Zana!' memory suggests it embodies Valdo's neglect; the wiki does not state this.

name: The Infinite Hunger
summary: Primary champion of the Tangle fought in the Seething Chyme.

name: Inya, the Unbearable Whispers
summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0 and removed in 3.17.0 per the wiki; in 3.0.0 the Pale Council was rebalanced and Inya became a drop source for Inya's Epiphany.

sources.locator: Infobox: location = The Pale Court; Drops: 'guaranteed to drop Inya's Epiphany ... if she was the last one to be killed ... the sequence ... is random'; Version history 3.17.0 'Removed from the game'

name: Irasha
summary: Maraketh akhara of Highgate and rival of Tasuni for rule after Oyun's disappearance. Her twin sister died of a scorpion's sting during the womanhood trial; she asks the exile to kill Shakari and may receive the Sekhema Feather.

name: Isla, the Engineer
summary: Engineer building Kingsmarch's map devices and the Recombinator; her letter ('I'm so happy you're alive!') hints at a past connection with the Exile and mentions Kalguuran runes' strange effect on portals.

sources.locator: Lead and Lore: "a skillset she acquired working under Inquisitor Dominus"

alt_summaries.summary: Engineer rogue hireable for Heists; per the wiki she worked under Inquisitor Dominus ~20 years before the PoE1 campaign and designed The Unbreakable, the design of which was stolen by the Templar. Also operates the Recombinator and Kalguuran Map Devices in Kingsmarch.
Former Templar chosen by Venarius to maintain the Map Device; now in Kingsmarch corresponding with Zana and experimenting with Kalguuran runes in map devices.

name: It That Fled
summary: Breach-realm creature that fled the Breachlords' rule and is listed among Immortal Syndicate members; most Syndicate members fear it. (Not in Keepers league.) Identity beyond that unclear.

sources.locator: 13:26 "being from the breach realm who fled the rule of the Breachlords"; 17:53 most members terrified of it
restrictions: It That Fled cannot appear in the Immortal Syndicate

name: It That Was Esh
summary: Hive Colony boss fought together with It That Was Tul (PoE1 3.27/3.28, PoE2 0.5.0). Per Ailith it is not the original Esh but possibly Esh's leftover remains after the fusion into Xesht.

alt_summaries.summary: Former Breachlord boss in the Hive Colony (paired with Tul).

name: It That Was Tul
summary: Hive Colony boss fought together with It That Was Esh (PoE1 3.27/3.28, PoE2 0.5.0); drops the Breachlord Sac / Breach rings. Per Ailith it is not the original Tul but possibly Tul's leftover remains after the fusion into Xesht.

alt_summaries.summary: Former Breachlord boss in the Hive Colony.

name: Ixan Keita
summary: Founder of House Keita, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

name: Ixchel
summary: Vaal Order of the Djinn member ('Godstealer') who stole the sleeping body of Yaomac for the Order; captured while infiltrating the Temple of Chaos and became the Trialmaster.

name: Emperor Izaro
summary: The last Phrecian emperor, impotent from inbreeding, who built the Lord's Labyrinth in 1317 IC to choose a successor. Sealed inside by Chitus. The Exile can still meet him as an enemy in the Labyrinth.

sources.locator: section 'Reign of Izaro'; section 'Reign of Chitus'

alt_summaries.summary: Last Phrecian Emperor; childless, he built the Lord's Labyrinth to choose a successor. Chitus won it, then sealed Izaro inside. The exile fights him in the Labyrinth.

name: Jaetai, Vaal Advisor
summary: Vaal advisor to Atziri mentioned only on the flavour text of Atziri's Foible.

name: Janus Perandus
summary: Great-grandson of Chitus Perandus; former Order of the Djinn member and gambling addict who betrayed the order to Catarina and joined the Syndicate.

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus' great-grandson; Immortal Syndicate member who betrayed the Order of the Djinn.

name: Johan, the King's Hand
summary: Kalguuran official sent to execute Kingsmarch's Charter as the King's Hand and Treasurer; admits loyalty to both the King and the Charter's law; tolerates 'less than upstanding' residents so long as he sees no sedition. He bears a scar given by Gwennen.

name: Julius Perandus
summary: Father of Chitus.

name: Jun Ortoi
summary: Master NPC, survivor and guardian of the Forbidden Vaults of the Order of the Djinn; hunts the Syndicate after its killing of her order. Introduced in Betrayal; Act 9 quest "The Immortal Syndicate".

sources.locator: 1:05 Jun Ortoi, Order of the Djinn

alt_summaries.summary: Veteran Order of the Djinn member; in PoE2 mentioned as rebuilding the Order since Catarina's fall 20 years earlier.

name: Justicar Casticus
summary: Templar justicar in the Control Blocks whose Eyes of Zeal give entry to the Templar Courts.

name: Kadavrus the Defiler
summary: Necromancer boss of the Fetid Pool who was raising the dead rhoa.

name: Kahuturoa
summary: Chieftain of the Rongokurai tribe per the Karui page (some history text files him with the Ramako tribe); recounts Ramako, Kitava's defeat and the Maraketh 'thousand years'.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

name: K'aj A'alai
summary: Third demon of the Vaal Temple map boss trio, variants of the Atziri trio; all released with Sacrifice of the Vaal.

name: K'aj Q'ura
summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map, a variant of the Atziri trio; uses Demon Cleave (Corrupted Blood) and Cyclone.

name: K'aj Y'ara'az
summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map; one of a trio that are variants of the Atziri trio of the Apex of Sacrifice. Uses Dual Strike and Fire Enrage.

name: Kalandra
summary: Ancient being with an owl's body and human head, trapped in the Lake of Kalandra since the primordial era; she observes the world, scorns gods as 'thieves of virtue', and plans escape. Visited by the Order of the Djinn and the Clayshaper among others. Namesake of the Mirror of Kalandra.

alt_summaries.summary: Ancient owl-bodied being trapped in her lake since the primordial era; disdains gods ('thieves of virtue') and is said to have counselled Sin on creating the Beast.

name: King Kaom
summary: Karui king who took Lioneye's Watch, was lured to Highgate by Malachai's voice posing as Tukohama and slain; defeated in Act 4.

alt_summaries.summary: King of the Karui (chieftain of the Ngamahu tribe) who invaded Lioneye's Watch for Voll's Purity Rebellion; later deceived by a vision from the 'black spirit', entered the Highgate mines, was corrupted by Malachai and sealed in with the Beast by Deshret; boss in Kaom's Stronghold (Act 4) holding the Eye of Fury.

name: Karst
summary: Lockpicking rogue in the Rogue Harbour; a Ring member (Kurai: 'assist member Karst') who aids the exile on the Trial Run contract and whose hire unlocks Huck.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: "Talk to Karst, the Lockpick, the rogue that aids you"
'The Ring' dialogue: 'assist member Karst on this job'

name: Kastov
summary: Governor of Stridevolf in the Eternal Empire who joined High Templar Voll's Purity Rebellion in 1333 IC against the gemling thaumatocracy. Per the Victario page, unlike Voll, Ondar, Geofri and Adus he did not turn undead or into a ghost in the in-game present.

sources.locator: intro paragraph: 'Governor Kastov of Stridevolf' listed among Voll's allies with Lord Mayor Ondar, Victario, Archbishop Geofri and Commander Adus

paragraph 'In 1333 IC, Victario supported the Purity Rebellion ... along with Kastov, Lord Mayor Ondar, Archbishop Geofri and Commander Adus'; and 'neither Victario nor Kastov turned into the undead or a ghost'
section '==Members==' > Purity Rebellion rebels: '** [[Kastov]], Governor of [[Stridevolf]]'

name: Kiloava
summary: Chieftain of the Valako tribe, absorbed by Kaom's conquests; speaks on how tribes may change their gods.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

name: King Cadigan
summary: Mysterious tyrant-king of Kalguur whose name all kings share (possibly one person extending life by artifice); spies on subjects, instituted shipment taxes, has his eye on Wraeclast, and in PoE2 ordered Vaal artifacts brought home.

sources.locator: Negative outcomes: 'The King decided to institute a one-time tax'

alt_summaries.summary: Current infamous ruler of Kalguur, always named Cadigan; rumoured to use artifice to extend life and spy on subjects; Kalguuran NPCs avoid speaking of him. In PoE2 he orders Vaal artifacts brought to Kalguur.

name: King Cadigan the Third
summary: Kalguuran king who, after reading the Vaal Cataclysm as an 'Omen', commissioned the first expedition to Wraeclast with the Triskelion Flame and banned gems after the Azmeri panicked at the sight of one.

chronology.relative: Shortly after the Vaal Cataclysm (first Kalguuran expedition)

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran king who commissioned the expedition and banned gems after Azmeri panic over gem drawings.
Ordered the first Kalguuran expedition to Wraeclast carrying the Triskelion Flame; banned collection of virtue gems after the Azmeri's fearful reaction.

name: Kira, Servant of Garukhan
summary: Maraketh warrior who leads a dekhara (warband), obsessed with Garukhan, the 'Vulture of the Wastes'. She kidnaps Sekhema Oyun to sacrifice her, hoping to become a 'Red Sekhema' and wearing the Sekhema Feather; the exile kills her and Garukhan but fails to save Oyun.

alt_summaries.summary: Act 4 weapon and armour vendor in Highgate.

name: Commander Kirac
summary: Tracker and officer of Oriath's volunteer Citizen Vanguard, later Commander; younger brother of Baran. In legacy epilogue quests he asked the Exile to find Baran, who had fallen in with 'radical' Zana Caeserius. Sits in the Karui Shores War Room, issues maps, pinnacle invitations and Atlas Books of Skill, calls the Exile 'Godslayer' and backs the Maven as 'the best of our terrible options'. Took Sirus's blow meant for Zana. His dialogue says the Maven resurrects Baran for her games.

sources.locator: Karui Shores: Helena directs the player to Commander Kirac in the War Room, who gives a Tier 1 map
quote: 'My younger brother, Baran, fell in with a radical by the name of Zana Caeserius'
KiracOnBaranResurrectionTwo; Introduction: 'tracker and officer in Oriath's new Citizen Vanguard'
Kirac: 'She's the best of our terrible options'

alt_summaries.summary: Oriath officer. In the older Epilogue (v3.9-3.16, 'Picking Up the Pieces', now removed) Officer Kirac sends the exile to the Templar Laboratory to find his brother Baran and learn about Zana; in the current Epilogue Commander Kirac waits in the War Room at Karui Shores and hands the exile the first Map (A Call to Arms).

name: Kishara
summary: Vaal explorer from Atziri's time who fell out of favour; Atziri seized her ship and sacrificed its crew. She hid Kishara's Star near the Causeway and her descendants formed the Brinerot clan.

name: Kole
summary: Unique demon monster in The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3), with a high-damage Ground Smash and a chain pull. Per the wiki's lore section (attributed to Grigor), Kole was an Oriathan rapist whom Piety used in her experiments. A stronger Carnage variant appeared in the Tower Map (2.4.0-3.1.0).

chronology.relative: Act 3 (c. Piety's experiments; relative date unknown)

sources.locator: Infobox: location = The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3); Lore: 'According to Grigor, Kole was an Oriathan ... before Piety used him in her experiments'

name: Korell Goya
summary: Syndicate member from the Redblade warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Kraityn
summary: Bandit lord of the Broken Bridge, exiled from Theopolis in 1598 IC for avarice, larceny, murder and more (Letters of Exile).

name: K'Tash, the Hate Shepherd
summary: Scourge boss (K'tash, the Hate Shepherd) that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats but no individual lore.

name: Kurai
summary: Administrator of the Rogue Harbour; starts the introductory Rogue Harbour quest in Act 6 and hands out the first contract.

name: Kurgal, the Blackblooded
summary: Abyssal Lich, commander of the Lightless and servant of Kulemak. Boss in the Lich's Tomb in Delve (depth 90+); born from a stone golem Kulemak created in his bargain with Aul.

alt_summaries.summary: Kurgal is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.
Lich Lord under Kulemak; a Delve boss in PoE1 (The Lich's Tomb, depth 90+) and named as a PoE2 Lich Lord by the Lurking Creature.

name: Kylian Cyaxan
summary: Founder of House Cyaxan, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

name: Lani
summary: Leader of the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower (Act 5) and hub NPC of the Oriath Docks in Act 10; she tells how Vilenta betrayed her and Bannon, is fond of Bannon, and rewards the exile after Kitava's fall.

alt_summaries.summary: Karui slave rebel at Overseer's Tower who rewards the Exile; knows of Kitava's Torments; says she 'helped bring this curse down upon Oriath'.

name: Lavianga
summary: Karui scholar-advisor to Kaom.

name: Lazhwar
summary: Archbishop of the Eternal Faith whose thaumaturgy and Eternal Laboratory work preceded Malachai's.

name: Leo, Master of the Arena
summary: Pit master of the Sarn arena; forsaken master of PvP missions. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Lilly Roth
summary: Pirate captain and granddaughter of Weylam Roth; her ship brings the exile to Lioneye's Watch (Act 6) and back to Oriath (Act 10). She is the gem vendor, asks the exile to clear the Twilight Strand, to retrieve The Teardrop (map to Tsoatha) and, after Kitava's death, offers to sail the exile away.

sources.locator: Lilly offers to ferry exile to Oriath
Lilly: drowned Oriathans washing ashore after cultists plunder refugee ships
Lilly: Templar privateers took the Teardrop; she and her grandfather plan to sail to Tsoatha

alt_summaries.summary: Ship captain who ferries survivors from Oriath to Wraeclast.

name: Lorrata
summary: Giant tree over the Vaal Ruins in the Wetlands, said to be the oldest tree in the area and planted by ancient Azmeri travellers (per Eramir); its roots held the Vaal doors shut until poisoned by the Exile with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem.

name: Lucan Octavius
summary: Wealthy Oriathan alchemist, Tane's master; publicly genial but violent and lustful in private; killed by Tane, who was exiled for it.

name: Lundara
summary: Twin sister Sekhema; possibly Lunaris.

name: Lycia, Herald of the Scourge
summary: Former Templar scholar and keeper of forbidden knowledge who, disillusioned by the truth of Innocence's origins and the Templars' unmarked ossuary bones, made a pact with the Scourge demon Beidat for immortality; imprisoned in the Sanctum she is its fourth-floor boss and league antagonist.

chronology.relative: lived sometime after the Eternal Empire's founding; exact date unknown (video guesses c. 1000-1300 IC)

sources.locator: page summary: former Templar, necromancy and lithomancy, immortality in pact with Beidat

alt_summaries.summary: Former Templar who uncovered the real story of Sin and Innocence.

name: Maata
summary: Chieftain of the Tawhoa tribe; her text discusses the Vaal.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

name: Malachai
summary: Laureate Thaumaturge to Chitus, creator of the gemling legions and Rapture Device. Spared by Voll, he entered the Beast and caused the Cataclysm. Defeated by the exile in Act 4.

sources.locator: intro paragraph 5 and section 'The Cataclysm (~1339 IC)'; 'Reign of Voll'

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus's Laureate Thaumaturge. He persuaded Voll to spare him, built the Rapture Device, and used it at Highgate to breach the Belly of the Beast, triggering the Cataclysm (c. 1339 IC).

Chitus's master thaumaturge, spared by Emperor Voll after promising 'the end to thaumaturgy'; built the Rapture Device, entered the Beast to take its power, and brought on the Cataclysm; final boss of Act 4 in the Black Core.
Act 4 boss whose lieutenants Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre are revived and harvested in Part Two.
Thaumaturge following in Doryani's footsteps.

name: Maligaro
summary: Inquisitor Maligaro, flesh artist of the Godless Three; burned by Voll, his spirit lived on in Maligaro's Sanctum; killed in Act 7.

alt_summaries.summary: Thaumaturge of Malachai's Godless Three; worked in the Chamber of Sins; burned by Voll; returns in Act 4 as the Inquisitor boss.
Thaumaturgist and Malachai disciple who worked flesh in the Chamber of Sins; his spirit is killed in Act 7.

name: Maramoa
summary: Karui exile from Ngamakanui (sentenced 1597 IC) who survives in the Sarn Encampment; he appears in Acts 3 and 8. In Act 8 he warns of the Gemling Legion and of the awakened Solaris and Lunaris, and sends the exile to take the Sun and Moon Orbs from their devotees.

alt_summaries.summary: Exile at the Sarn Encampment who gives Lost in Love and Sever the Right Hand; uses Karui terms (makoru, waikoama) so is probably Karui (inferred). The 'leader' role in the earlier draft was not supported.

name: General Marceus Lioneye
summary: Eternal Empire general and leader of the Gemling Legion; archer with a virtue gem in one eye; defeated by Hyrri's ambush at Lioneye's Watch during the Purity Rebellion. (General of the Eternal Empire legion in Legion league, 3.7.0.)

sources.locator: Purity Rebellion: Kaom wore his head on his belt

alt_summaries.summary: Gem-eyed archer general at Lioneye's Watch, killed by Kaom.
Eternal Empire general and leader of the Gemling Legion, a one-eyed (virtue gem) archer; sent to drive off Kaom during the Purity Rebellion and killed at Lioneye's Watch, which is named for him.

name: Marylene
summary: Victario's lover, died shielding him at the Grain Gate.

name: The Maven
summary: Primordial claimant of the Atlas who is 'bored with the realm she has given', serving only her own amusement; not the Elder but to be feared. She witnesses map bosses and traps challengers in her Memory Game. Her origin is unresolved.

sources.locator: Envoy: 'She is not The Elder, but you are right to fear her.'

name: Maxarius
summary: Per the Sanctum relic texts (as recounted in the wiki and video), Maxarius, the first High Templar, was in truth Innocence himself - a charlatan who stole the Descry symbol from fire-terrified newcomers, used their fear, and vilified his brother Sin to ascend.

chronology.relative: ancient, when the Azmeri still lived in the Azmerian mountains

sources.locator: [28:00]-[30:30] relics reveal Maxarius = Innocence; quote 'a charlatan, a liar and a power seeker'
===Templar history (line ~188): "The very first High Templar, Maxarius, was not Innocence's chosen, as was told, but Innocence himself."
Lore: "He posed himself as Maxarius, the first High Templar, and vilified his own brother as the Original Evil."

name: Medici Perandus
summary: Member of the Perandus family styled 'Prefect to the Treasury'. The corpus knows him only from the flavour text of the Perandus Signet; no dated action is recorded, so his era is unknown.

sources.locator: section '===Medici Perandus===': 'Medici Perandus, "Prefect to the Treasury", is a member of the Perandus family only referred to by the flavour text of Perandus Signet.'
section '==Members==' > Perandus family: 'Medici Perandus, Prefect to the Treasury'

name: Medved
summary: Leader of the Druids of the Broken Circle who claimed to peer into the past. He pioneered culling a horror species, challenged the horrors' leader alone and vanished. He returns as a horror boss in PoE1 (Medved, Feller of Heroes).

chronology.relative: Expedition era, thousands of years before PoE1

sources.locator: section 'The Kalguur' (Broken Circle, Priesthood, Medved's challenge)

alt_summaries.summary: Druid of the Broken Circle who discovered soul vapour leaving corpses toward gems; became a horror champion, Medved, Feller of Heroes.
Leader of the Druids of the Broken Circle of Kalguur, rumoured to see the future by peering into the past; experiments with virtue gems.
Ancient Kalguuran whose tomb opens the Expedition storyline; not as dead as expected.

name: Meginord
summary: Figure referred to only in flavour text and names of unique belts (e.g. Meginord's Girdle, Meginord's Vise). The wiki says he ruled a northern part of Wraeclast, but it is unclear whether he is a person or a naming pun.

sources.locator: Intro: 'a figure only mentioned in the flavour text and names of unique items'; Lore: 'it is unclear whether the character was intended to be called north-north'

name: Merveil, the Siren
summary: Former court beauty of Sarn who married the swordsman Daresso; the cursed Star of Wraeclast he gave her transformed her into a siren-like monster who bore monstrous children; Act 1 final boss (Cavern of Anger / Merveil's Lair).

alt_summaries.summary: Daresso's wife transformed into a siren by the Star of Wraeclast.

name: Mother Gull
summary: Figure who pitied Great Fire survivors and gave them grain and water that was tainted, causing cannibalism.

name: Nashta, the Usurper
summary: Maraketh warrior and sister of Adiyah who tried to start a civil war in the Maraketh by stealing Solerai's Spear and attacking caravans; the exile and Adiyah kill her in the final contract.

sources.locator: Lore: sister Nashta, Solerai's Spear, Contract: Heart of Glory

name: Nasima
