summary: Ancient being whose rage created the Well of Souls, power source of necromancy; nothing else known.

name: Ngamahu
summary: Karui Ancestor/god honoured by a Karui tribe in the Trial of the Ancestors.

sources.locator: Halls of the Dead test; Karui tattoos by god's domain

alt_summaries.summary: Karui goddess of fire, Mother of Fire; honoured in Ngamakanui.

name: Order
summary: Impulse opposed to Chaos, representing dominion and control; Hinekora is its servant per wiki analysis; in one timeline Order overcame Chaos through Venarius's enslavement of humanity.

alt_summaries.summary: Impulse opposed to Chaos; almost nothing is known.

name: Prospero
summary: Azmerian god of wealth and the underworld, patron of the Perandus family; Cadiro struck a deal for long life.

alt_summaries.summary: Azmerian god of the underworld, patron of Cadiro.

name: Ralakesh
aliases: Ralakesh, Master of a Million Faces
summary: God of subjugation and control, Master of a Million Faces, brother of Tangmazu. Eramir says he ruled a Vaal city and enslaved Azmeri to repopulate it; the God page lists him among Azmerian/Eternal gods. His relic possessed Greust; in the Act 7 quest The Master of a Million Faces the Exile kills Greust and Sin then drains and kills Ralakesh.

sources.locator: intro + Lore (Eramir/Sin quotes); 'Sin will then kill Ralakesh by draining its power'

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal god obsessed with control and governance; possesses Greust through a relic in Act 7 and is killed in the Forest Encampment.
Vaal god, Master of a Million Faces, who controlled a Vaal city through 'animal instincts' and nearly caused its extinction; killed by the Exile in PoE1 Act 7.

name: Ramako, Father of the Sun
summary: Karui Ancestor/god honoured by a Karui tribe in the Trial of the Ancestors. claimed he was impersonated

alt_summaries.summary: Karui god of light and the sun; husband of Sione; fathered Arohongui in an alleged affair with Lani Lua, which he claims was an impostor.

name: Rongokurai, Father of the Night
summary: Karui Ancestor/god honoured by a Karui tribe in the Trial of the Ancestors. whose darkness covered the visits to Sione

alt_summaries.summary: Karui god of the night; accused of helping Ramako's affair; on bad terms with Ramako.

name: Ryslatha, the Puppet Mistress
summary: Parasite-queen goddess (a carrion-insect queen covered in parasites) found in the Spawning Ground of the Wetlands. Per Sin she was once a revered matriarch whose children were slaughtered by Tukohama's warriors and who now wants to make everyone's children hers; the Azmeri believed her offspring would one day overwhelm the world. Minor Pantheon god.

sources.locator: Sin on the Azmeri belief about Ryslatha's offspring
Act 6 dialogue "The Puppet Mistress" / "Ryslatha": tribe matriarch, children butchered by Tukohama's warriors

alt_summaries.summary: Former Azmeri matriarch who lost her children to Tukohama's warriors and became a parasitic carrion queen; Act 6 Pantheon boss.

name: Saqawal, First of the Sky
summary: Spirit Beast avatar of the First Ones, First of the Sky ('Last of the First'), ancestor of birds and reptiles; Bestiary encounter.

alt_summaries.summary: One of the named Ezomyte First Ones, god-like immortal beings of the sky; stilled the Great Fire's flames.

name: The Searing Exarch
summary: Eldritch Horror serving the Cleansing Fire; seeks to master the Atlas; fought in the Absence of Patience and Wisdom.

name: Shakari, Queen of the Sands
summary: Maraketh scorpion-goddess, daughter of Sin and Garukhan; hides in the Oasis behind a sandstorm rebuilding an ancient army and is killed in the Sand Pit (Act 9). Minor Pantheon god.

sources.locator: Intro: daughter of Garukhan and Sin

alt_summaries.summary: Daughter of Sin and Garukhan; Queen of the Sands, twisted scorpion-like by lust for power; optional Act 9 boss.

name: Sin
summary: God, brother (twin, per the stained-glass windows) of Innocence; planted the Dark Ember beneath Highgate from which the Beast grew. In PoE1 he guides the Exile against Kitava; in PoE2 the Hooded One reveals in Act 2 that he is Sin.

sources.locator: 'The Hooded One was likely Sin, owing to his dark appearance, apparent godhood and original planting of the Dark Ember'
intro paragraph 3 (Sin plants the Dark Ember; Beast initiates the Slumber of the Gods)
section 'Lore' (Sin captures Innocence's soul; Sin and the Exile defeat Kitava in Act 10)
Lore: reveals himself as Sin at the end of Act 2
Lore, The Beast, In-game interactions, Path of Exile 2
"I am Sin, the Forgotten One." / Act 6: "I am Sin, Thief of Virtue, and it is mine to take what I will from the defeated"
Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest'

alt_summaries.summary: A god vilified as Sin, who planted the Dark Ember in Highgate to create the Beast and triggered the Slumber of the Gods. In PoE1 Act 10 the Exile and Sin defeat Kitava.

God, twin brother of Innocence, 'Thief of Virtue', creator of the Beast and Exile's ally in PoE1 Act 5-10 (sources the Pantheon); husband of Garukhan, father of Shakari. In PoE2 he hides as the Hooded One.
Brother of Innocence, creator of the Beast; appears to the Exile in the Chamber of Innocence and saves them from Kitava.

Thief of Virtue, twin brother of Innocence and creator of the Beast via the Dark Ember seed; in Part Two he guides the exile to harvest the souls of risen gods and Malachai's lieutenants to forge a new Dark Ember and defeat Kitava. Returns in PoE2 as 'the Hooded One'.
God Sin, 'Thief of Virtue'. In PoE2 Act 2 the Hooded One reveals himself as Sin and as the creator of the Beast.

PoE1 god, twin brother of Innocence (the stained-glass version of their tale is Templar propaganda), who planted the Dark Ember/Seed beneath Highgate to grow the Beast and lull the gods; in PoE2 he is the Hooded One (revealed in Act 2).
God who created the Beast.

curation: codex: identity stated outright in Act 2 (event_hooded_one_reveals_sin)

name: Sione
summary: Karui Mother of the Sun, wife of Ramako, locked in endless battle with Lani Lua. See Lani Lua node for wiki inconsistency on which is sun/moon.

name: Solaris
summary: Eternal/Azmeri sun goddess, twin sister of Lunaris; led a rival cult after Tangmazu tricked her into believing Lunaris betrayed her. Sin has her soul captured for the Pantheon in Act 8. (PoE2 appearance of Solaris/Lunaris by name not verified in the local PoE2 corpus; Maraketh variants Solerai/Lundara and the Three Sisters myth cover PoE2.)

alt_summaries.summary: Minimal node (owned elsewhere): Sun/Moon deity of the Eternal/Templar pantheon.

Azmerian god of the Sun, sister of Lunaris and Viridi, recognised and worshipped by the Eternal Empire; she and Lunaris awaken in Act 8 and are summoned to the Harbour Bridge with the Sun and Moon Orbs and killed. Their flavour texts suggest a possible link to the Maraketh Sekhemas Solerai and Lundara (speculative).

name: Tangmazu
summary: Trickster god (Tekaru to the Karui, Black Crow to the Ezomytes), Ralakesh's brother, said to have made Solaris and Lunaris fight; listed on the wiki as an NPC related to Delirium and, in PoE2, revealed as the disguised Freya Hartlin whose release triggers a Delirium encounter.

sources.locator: Freya Hartlin reveals herself as Tangmazu
Quest: Journey's End and Tangmazu reveal
Solaris, Lunaris and Viridi footnote on the Raven Trickster

alt_summaries.summary: Trickster god (Raven Trickster / Tekaru / Black Crow), brother of Ralakesh, who caused the Solaris-Lunaris feud. The Strange Voice of Delirium mirrors; in PoE2 he is bound in Kedge Bay by Karui bindings, disguised as Freya Hartlin, and freed in Dark Mists.

Trickster being imprisoned by the Ramako and later Tukohama tribes at Journey's End; disguised as Freya Hartlin, freed with Verisium Spikes, triggering a Delirium encounter. Elder Madox later calls the Raven Trickster 'he of many names and many faces' (identification only implied).

name: Tasalio
summary: Karui Ancestor/god honoured by a Karui tribe in the Trial of the Ancestors.

alt_summaries.summary: Karui god of water, Father of Water.

name: Tawhoa
summary: Karui Ancestor/god honoured by a Karui tribe in the Trial of the Ancestors.

alt_summaries.summary: Karui god of the forest and birds, Father of the Forest.

name: The Draiocht
summary: Goddess protecting the Azmeri, divided into the Three Sisters Mhacha, Catha, Morrigan who gave themselves to imbue nature; created the Wildwood and forbade gems. Original name lost.

name: The First Ones
summary: Animalistic gods worshipped by the Ezomytes, believed to roam the realm of Spirit; their avatars are Spirit Beasts: Saqawal (birds/reptiles, 'Last of the First'), Farrul (hounds/cats/mammals, 'First of the Hunt'), Fenumus (insects, 'First Explorer'), Craiceann (crabs/squid/sea life, 'First of All'). Also The Greatwolf and the Gull.

sources.locator: Craiceann section: avatar of the First Ones

alt_summaries.summary: Group of animalistic Ezomyte gods including Craiceann, Farrul, Fenumus, Saqawal, the Greatwolf and the Gull; roam the realm of Spirit.

name: The Forgotten Daughter
summary: Unique monster in Act 2 Fellshrine Ruins representing Sin and Innocence's sister, from before the gods; presumably never ascended.

name: The Molten One
summary: Last surviving Titan from a prehistoric era, worshipped indirectly as the volcano home of the Redblade warband; writes environmental lore found in the Forge of the Titans.

alt_summaries.summary: Last known Titan from a prehistoric era, indirectly worshipped as the volcano home of the Redblade warband.

name: The Spirit
summary: Mysterious entity with which Yeena (Act 2) communicates; listed among Azmerian/Eternal gods on the God page. Nothing more is stated.

name: Thruldana
summary: God whose name Undertaker Arimor invokes in a chant; nothing else is known.

name: Tukohama
summary: Karui god of war; his tooth slashed Kitava's face. Revived by the Beast's death, he raises the Karui Fortress and is the first god the Exile captures for the Pantheon in Act 6. Kaom claimed to be his son (carvings in Kaom's Stronghold).

alt_summaries.summary: Karui god of war and minor Pantheon god; the first god the exile kills, in his Keep in the Karui Fortress. Defeating him unlocks the first Pantheon power.
Karui god of war; in the Act 4 boss fight Tavakai calls on him ('Lend me your strength') and Tukohama refuses: 'This... is not the Way.'

name: Tul, Creeping Avalanche
summary: One of five Breachlords. Cold Breachlord (female per wiki). Boss residing in Tul's Domain; Breachstone/Flawless Breachstone via map device (PoE1 2.5.0; domains removed 3.28.0).

sources.locator: boss page: found in Hive Colony, encountered together with the other

alt_summaries.summary: Breachlord (Tul) fought as a paired boss with its counterpart in the Hive Colony (PoE2 0.5); they share a health bar in the final phase and drop the Breachlord Sac.

name: Uul-Netol, Unburdened Flesh
summary: One of five Breachlords. Physical damage Breachlord. Boss residing in Uul-Netol's Domain; Breachstone/Flawless Breachstone via map device (PoE1 2.5.0; domains removed 3.28.0).

name: Vaal Oversoul
summary: Shadowy Vaal spirit entity at the top of the Ancient Pyramid; final boss of Act 2; summoned by The Apex on the Dark Altar.

sources.locator: intro; map variant 'Vessel of the Vaal'
boss header; Shadow of the Vaal
boss header; Shadow of the Vaal
section 'Atziri's rule', Doryani's Machinarium flavour text

alt_summaries.summary: Colossal Vaal entity summoned on the Dark Altar in the Ancient Pyramid with The Apex; Act 2 final boss. Wiki gives no explicit lore on its nature; its relation to Vaal soul-worship is inferred.

Giant Vaal construct and final boss of PoE1 Act 2, fought on the top floor of the Ancient Pyramid after using The Apex on the Dark Altar; Doryani's Machinarium flavour text suggests (inference) Doryani created it. Defeating it opens the way to Act 3's Sarn.

name: Valako
summary: Karui god of storms and lightning; his jaw became a fish hook, one of Kitava's Torments.

sources.locator: Lani: 'A fish hook that was once the Valako's Jaw'

name: Viridi
summary: Third sister of Solaris and Lunaris, Azmeri goddess of the earth, trapped within 'the orb' in Azmeri creation myth; probable namesake of the Viridian Wildwood.

name: Xesht
summary: Incomplete union of the Breachlords Xoph, Tul, Esh and Uul-Netol after the five-Breachlord merge failed (Chayula was severed); filled with mindless rage and hunger. PoE1 fought it as Xesht-Ula, the Open Hand; in PoE2 0.5 it is the Breach pinnacle ('Xesht, We That Are One' per a guide), reached through a Breachstone/Realmgate.

sources.locator: Trivia: Xesht is the incomplete fusion of Xoph, Esh, Tul, Uul-Netol; Chayula opposes as the Dreamer
Dialogue "Who is our enemy?": "Xoph... Esh... Tul... Uul-Netol... our melding... failed... They became Xesht."
Lore: failed merge of the five Breachlords; Chayula severed, rest formed Xesht
Lore: failed merge; the rest of the Breachlords formed an incomplete union in the form of Xesht
Xesht: fought by communing with the Dreamer
Xesht, We That Are One: Breach Splinters form a Breachstone, slotted into the Realmgate

alt_summaries.summary: Entity of the Breach (PoE2 wiki: Xesht): the incomplete fusion of four Breachlords (Xoph, Esh, Tul, Uul-Netol) after the planned five-way merger failed; Chayula was severed from the union and opposes it as the Dreamer. Per the Dreamer, Xesht is 'four minds sewn together' filled with endless rage and hunger.

name: Xoph, Dark Embers
summary: One of five Breachlords (fire). Boss of Xoph's Domain, accessed via Xoph's Breachstone in a map device (2.5.0; removed from game 3.28.0). Model based on a Marauder; one of four lords fused into Xesht.

name: Yaomac
summary: Ancient Vaal god with three serpentine heads, worshipped by Vaalish priests. Ixchel stole his sleeping body for the Order of the Djinn; the Trialmaster refers to Yaomac when the player wins five or more times.

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal shepherd of souls with three serpentine heads who maintains the balance of seasons.
Three-headed serpent Vaal deity, shepherd of Vaal souls and arbiter of the seasons' balance.

name: Yugul, Reflection of Terror
summary: Former Vaal scholar of fear who ascended by terrifying children and Vaal leaders; a maw-god killed in the High Gardens.

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal scholar obsessed with fear who used mirrors to petrify terror; ascended through worship; slain by the Exile in Act 8 (Reflection of Terror).
Vaal scholar of fear who ascended to godhood through mirrors that 'petrify fear'; killed by the Exile in PoE1 Act 8.

name: Ancient Azmeri/Ezomyte Age
aliases: Ancient Azmeri, Ezomyte, Maraketh and Karui Era
summary: Era of the primeval civilisation, Winter of the World, Lightless war and the ancient Azmeri, Ezomyte, Maraketh and Karui peoples, before the Eternal Empire (1 IC).

sources.locator: sections Primeval civilization, The Azmeri, The Maraketh, The Ezomytes
intro paragraph 2; sections 'The Azmeri', 'The Ezomytes', 'The Karui'

alt_summaries.summary: Post-Winter-of-the-World cultures (Azmeri, Maraketh, Ezomyte, Karui) and the Order of the Djinn that defeated the Lightless.

name: Eternal Empire (era)
summary: Umbrella period of the Eternal Empire (Sarn Empire) from Imperialis Conceptus (1 IC) through the Reign of Voll to the Cataclysm (~1339 IC). Split into the era_eternal_empire_rise and era_eternal_empire_fall buckets; the faction itself is faction_eternal_empire.

sources.locator: section '===Imperialis Conceptus (1 IC)===' (start) and '===The Cataclysm (~1339 IC)===' (end)

name: Eternal Empire Fall
summary: The later Eternal Empire: Izaro's Lord's Labyrinth (1317 IC), Chitus and the gemling legions, the Purity Rebellion (1333-1334 IC) and the Cataclysm (c. 1339 IC) that ends the empire. Boundary with the 'rise' bucket is a convention.

sources.locator: sections 'Reign of Izaro', 'The Purity Rebellion', 'The Cataclysm (~1339 IC)'

name: Eternal Empire Rise
summary: From 1 IC: Tarcus Veruso leads the Azmeri into the lands left by the Vaal and founds Sarn and the Eternal Empire; the empire expands; the Night of a Thousand Ribbons (c. 334 IC) ends Romira's reign.

sources.locator: section 'The Eternal Empire': 'Imperialis Conceptus (1 IC)', 'Reign of Tarcus Veruso', 'Night of a Thousand Ribbons'

name: Interlude Between Games
summary: About 20 years between the defeat of Kitava and the PoE2 prelude: Count Geonor, Ogham, and the release of the Seed of Corruption.

sources.locator: section 'Prelude / Count Geonor' ('twenty years after the defeat of Kitava')

name: League storylines (PoE1 → PoE2)
summary: Era bucket for league and side storylines. They begin alongside the first Exile's journey, and many continue into Path of Exile 2 (e.g. Kingsmarch, Breach, Ritual, Expedition, Abyss), which is the continuation of the same world twenty years later.

sources.locator: section 'The Atlas of Worlds' (Day Zero rule)

curation: user review: leagues are not PoE1-only; PoE2 continues PoE1

name: PoE1 (era umbrella)
summary: Umbrella for the PoE1-era buckets: the Acts 1-10 campaign and Epilogue (era_poe1_campaign), the Atlas storylines (era_poe1_atlas) and the league storylines that begin alongside them (era_league_storylines, many of which continue into PoE2). Meta grouping only; no in-world event.

chronology.relative: before the ~20-year interlude that precedes PoE2

sources.locator: paragraph 3: 'An exile was responsible for killing the Beast around 20 years prior to the events of Path of Exile 2', which places the PoE1 events before the PoE2 era

name: PoE1 Atlas Storylines
summary: Endgame Atlas storylines after the campaign: the Shaper and the Elder, and later the Conquerors of the Atlas. Dates are not given beyond the 'Day Zero' rule.

sources.locator: section 'The Atlas of Worlds' and 'The Elder and the Shaper'

name: PoE1 Campaign (Acts 1-10)
summary: The Exile's first story: sentenced to Wraeclast by High Templar Dominus in 1599-1600 IC, the Exile crosses Wraeclast, defeats Dominus, and ends by defeating Kitava in Act 10.

name: Post-Cataclysm Oriath
summary: Oriath, the island unaffected by the Cataclysm, becomes a Templar theocracy; the Templar Courts and Chamber of Innocence are built under High Templar Avarius. Roughly 260 years pass before PoE1.

name: Post-Vaal Dark Age
summary: Ruins of the Vaal, the surviving Vaal absorbed into the Azmeri, and the Kalguur expedition that colonised and failed on Wraeclast.

chronology.relative: between the Vaal Cataclysm and 1 IC

name: Precursor Era
summary: Age of the Precursor civilisation, the only culture wholly predating the Winter of the World; its apex lies further before the Vaal than the Vaal lie before the present.

chronology.relative: before the Winter of the World

alt_summaries.summary: The Precursor civilization, the only culture that wholly predates the Winter of the World, with technology far beyond later peoples.

name: Primordial Wraeclast
summary: Earliest prehistory: a molten world with Kalandra trapped in her lake, the Titans, the Winter of the World and the Lightless attack. The wiki says the order of prehistoric events is unclear.

chronology.relative: before the Vaal; earliest prehistory (exact years unknown)

sources.locator: Prehistory: 'When Wraeclast was a primordial molten world of ooze and magma'

alt_summaries.summary: Earliest age of Wraeclast: a molten world of ooze and magma inhabited by Titans, in which Kalandra found her lake. Chronology is explicitly unclear.

name: Vaal Era
summary: The Vaal Empire under Queen Atziri, the use of virtue gems and sacrifice, ending in the Vaal Cataclysm.

alt_summaries.summary: Period of the Vaal civilisation up to the Vaal Cataclysm (c. 400 BIC).

name: A Dirty Job
summary: Tarkleigh sends the Exile to clear the Fetid Pool of the necromancer Kadavrus the Defiler who raises the dead rhoa. (Optional quest.)

name: Breaking Down the Door
summary: Act 1 quest exclusive to the Betrayal league (historical). Jun asks the Exile to help dismantle Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast and to defeat a Syndicate member there. It was replaced by The Immortal Syndicate after the league ended.

sources.locator: Header: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Betrayal league. After the league end it is replaced by The Immortal Syndicate'; Walkthrough: 'Jun wants you to help her find and dismantle the Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast'

lead: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Betrayal league. After the league end it is replaced by The Immortal Syndicate'; walkthrough: 'Jun wants you to help her find and dismantle the Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast'

alt_summaries.summary: Betrayal-league Act 1 quest: Jun asks the Exile to help dismantle Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast. After the league it was replaced by the Immortal Syndicate quest.

name: Breaking Some Eggs
summary: The Exile finds three Karui glyph shells in rhoa nests and fits them to the glyph wall in the Mud Flats to drain the Submerged Passage.

name: The Caged Brute
summary: The Exile kills Brutus, Warden of Axiom Prison, in the Warden's Chambers, opening the way through the Prison.

sources.locator: Walkthrough; Nessa dialogue on Brutus myth
Walkthrough; Nessa dialogue on Brutus myth

name: The Dweller of the Deep
summary: Tarkleigh asks the Exile to kill a giant crab nesting in the Flooded Depths. (Optional quest.)

name: Dying for a Fight
summary: Optional tutorial quest for the Trial of the Ancestors (Ancestor league, historical). A Silver Coin opens a portal to the Halls of the Dead; Navali, a revenant, tells the Exile that they have apparently died and sends them into the Halls of the Dead, where winning a tournament completes the quest.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: start 'Find a Silver Coin', objective 'Challenge the Ancestors'; Walkthrough: 'Rub it between your fingers in a Town or Hideout to open a portal to the Halls of the Dead'

lead: 'an optional tutorial quest for Trial of the Ancestors'; walkthrough quote from Navali: 'Your coming was foretold, but you are decades early ... I am Navali, once a hatungo'; 'Quest Complete - You have won a tournament in the Halls of the Dead'

alt_summaries.summary: Optional tutorial for the Trial of the Ancestors: after finding a Silver Coin, the Exile rubs it in town to open a portal to the Halls of the Dead, where Navali sets the trial.

name: Enemy at the Gate
summary: The Exile kills Hillock at the end of the Twilight Strand, opening Lioneye's Watch; Tarkleigh rewards them.

name: The Marooned Mariner
summary: Captain Fairgraves in the Ship Graveyard sends the Exile for the Allflame; he then tries to kindle it with the Exile's life, and is killed (the Exile later meets his spirit in Act 3). (Optional quest.)

name: Mercy Mission
summary: Nessa asks for a ship's Medicine Chest; Bestel says it lies on the Tidal Island where his Merry Gull ran aground; Hailrake holds it. (Optional quest.)

name: Prisoner of Fate
summary: Optional Act 1 quest (historical; the prophecy system was removed in 3.17.0). The Exile defeats the Faun in the Climb to free Navali, who thanks the Exile and teaches prophecies in Lioneye's Watch.

sources.locator: lead: 'Historical content ... the prophecy system was removed from the game in version 3.17.0'; walkthrough: 'Navali has been captured by the Faun in the Climb. Defeat the Faun to to rescue Navali'; Navali: 'Thank you for freeing me.'

name: Exiles Dumped onto the Twilight Strand
summary: The Exile is among about two dozen exiles dumped into the water off a ship by Dominus's Blackguards and washes up on the Twilight Strand; a Dying Exile says smoke was seen at ruins up the beach (the wiki does not describe a shipwreck as such).

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Dying Exile quote "We're all that made it? They dumped... two dozen of us exiles off that ship."
Walkthrough: Dying Exile quote "We're all that made it? They dumped... two dozen of us exiles off that ship."

name: The Siren's Cadence
summary: The Exile kills Merveil, the Siren, in her lair, freeing the coast and the way to the Southern Forest of Act 2.

name: The Way Forward (Thaumetic Seal)
summary: Optional quest given by Tarkleigh after entering the Ledge; spans Acts 1-2. Piety (who had met the Exile in the Warden's Chambers) raises Shavronne's old barricade at Prisoner's Gate; Silk mentions a stone carving by the south pass; in the Western Forest the Exile kills Captain Arteri for the Thaumetic Emblem to open the Thaumetic Seal, and is rewarded by Bestel.

chronology.relative: Given in Act 1 (after the Ledge), completed in Act 2 Western Forest

name: Deal with the Bandits
summary: Three bandit lords (Alira, Oak, Kraityn) terrorize the encampment; the Exile kills all three for a skill point, or kills two and sides with one for a permanent bonus.

name: Arrival at the Forest Encampment
summary: After Merveil the Exile enters the Southern Forest and the Forest Encampment, a small village (Helena calls it 'that Azmeri village by the river') of Greust, Silk, Yeena and Eramir, extorted by bandit lords.

name: The Great White Beast
summary: Yeena asks the Exile to end the suffering of a tortured great white beast in the Old Fields' Den. (Optional quest.)

name: Intruders in Black
summary: Greust sends the Exile after the 'warriors in black' (Blackguards) near the Chamber of Sins; the Exile kills Fidelitas, rescues Helena and takes the Baleful Gem from the Strange Device; Helena joins the encampment.

name: The Root of the Problem
summary: Helena has the Exile poison the great tree Lorrata in the Wetlands with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem, to open the Vaal ruins before Piety can.

name: Safe and Sound
summary: Optional Act 2 quest. Helena asks the Exile to find a Hideout location rumoured in the Dread Thicket beyond the Vaal Ruins; after clearing it the Exile claims the Hideout and uses its crafting bench to enhance an item.

sources.locator: infobox: act 2, start 'Talk to Helena'; walkthrough: 'Helena wants you to find a suitable location for a Hideout. There is one rumoured to be located in the Dread Thicket beyond the Vaal Ruins'; 'Quest Complete - You have claimed a Hideout'

name: Shadow of the Vaal
summary: Entering the Vaal Ruins the Exile's touching the Ancient Seal releases a darkness; the Exile climbs the Ancient Pyramid, uses The Apex on the Dark Altar and kills the Vaal Oversoul.

name: Sharp and Cruel
summary: Silk asks for his spear lodged in the eye of the Weaver; the Exile kills the Weaver and takes Maligaro's Spike.

name: Through Sacred Ground
summary: Yeena sends the Exile to the Crypt in Fellshrine for the Golden Hand of the 'good man' (Archbishop Geofri). (Optional quest.)

name: Fiery Dust
summary: Dialla has the Exile fetch Thaumetic Sulphite from the Docks so she can brew Infernal Talc to burn through the Undying Blockade in the Sewers.

name: A Fixture of Fate
summary: Siosa, a spectral presence in the Library, asks the Exile to find four Vaalish Golden Pages hidden by Icius Perandus in the Archives (behind a loose candle); he rewards gem access.

name: The Gemling Queen
summary: Grigor sends the Exile to Solaris Temple Level 2, where Lady Dialla the Gemling Queen still lives.

name: Lost in Love
summary: The Exile rescues Clarissa from Blackguards and retrieves Tolman's bracelet from the Crematorium where Piety tortured him to death; Piety flees.

name: Piety's Pets
summary: Grigor sends the Exile to kill Piety in her Lunaris Temple laboratory, where she makes miscreations; she drops the Tower Key (later revealed Malachai saved her).

name: The Ribbon Spool
summary: Dialla asks for her stolen Ribbon Spool from the Battlefront, held by the Ebony Legion. (Optional quest.)

name: Arrival at Sarn
summary: The Exile enters the ruined Eternal capital Sarn, overrun by undead, and reaches the Sarn Encampment (Hargan, Clarissa, Maramoa, Grigor).

name: The Sceptre of God
summary: With Piety's Tower Key the Exile climbs the Sceptre of God and kills High Templar Dominus; Lady Dialla appears and opens the way to Act 4.

name: Sever the Right Hand
summary: Maramoa tasks the Exile to kill General Gravicius in the Ebony Barracks across the river.

name: A Swig of Hope
summary: If Fairgraves died in Act 1, his spirit in the Docks asks for a decanter and fruit. (Optional quest.)

name: Victario's Secrets
summary: Hargan sends the Exile to the Sewers to find three platinum busts (Sentari, Titucius, Lioneye) that Victario stole from Chitus. (Optional quest.)

name: Breaking the Seal
summary: The Exile kills Voll, the Brittle Emperor in the Dried Lake, takes Deshret's Banner and breaks Deshret's Seal on the Mines.

name: Corpus Malachus
summary: Piety, defeated as an Abomination, requires three of Malachai's organs from his Godless Three (Maligaro, Shavronne, Doedre) to open the Black Core.

sources.locator: Walkthrough; Piety page Godless Three dialogue
Walkthrough; Piety page Godless Three dialogue

name: Arrival at Highgate
summary: Dialla meets the Exile at the Aqueduct and in Highgate asks them to destroy the Beast sealed in the mountain; Oyun and the Maraketh hold Highgate.

name: An Indomitable Spirit
summary: Tasuni asks the Exile to free the spirit of Sekhema Deshret trapped in the Mines Level 2. (Optional quest.)

name: The Eternal Nightmare: Malachai defeated
summary: The Exile kills Malachai, The Nightmare, in the Black Core; Piety dies impaled by him in the fight; the Beast dies, ending Act 4.

name: The King of Desire
summary: The Exile kills Daresso, King of Swords, in the Grand Arena and brings the Eye of Desire to Dialla.

name: The King of Fury
summary: The Exile kills King Kaom in Kaom's Stronghold and brings the Eye of Fury to Dialla.

name: Activation of the Rapture Device
summary: With the two Eyes the Rapture Device in the Crystal Veins is powered (Dialla's life force) and drills into the Belly of the Beast.

name: Death to Purity
summary: The Exile kills High Templar Avarius, vessel of the god Innocence, in the Chamber of Innocence; Sin appears.

name: In Service to Science
summary: Vilenta asks the Exile to recover her Miasmeter from Piety's laboratory. (Optional quest.)

name: The Key to Freedom
summary: Utula demands Justicar Casticus's faithful eyes; the Exile kills Casticus in the Control Blocks and takes the Eyes of Zeal to enter the Templar Courts.

name: The King's Feast
summary: Bannon asks the Exile to kill Utula to stop the King's Feast; Utula dies but completes the ritual that summons Kitava.

name: Kitava's Torments
summary: Lani sends the Exile to the Reliquary for three Karui artefacts (Hinekora's Hair, Tukohama's Tooth, Valako's Jaw) taken by the Templars from Ngamakanui. (Optional quest.)

name: Kitava Reawakens and Defeats the Exile
summary: At the end of Act 5 the reawakened Kitava cannot be beaten: his beam destroys the Sign of Purity and Sin snatches the exile from his jaws, telling them to take the ship to Lioneye's Watch. This begins Part Two.

sources.locator: "A ship sails for Lioneye's Watch not far from here. Be on it."
Act 5: battle cannot be won; Kitava's beam destroys the Sign of Purity and Sin saves the player

alt_summaries.summary: Kitava awakens and devours Oriath; the Exile uses the Sign of Purity on the Cathedral Rooftop, but Kitava destroys it; Sin saves the Exile and Captain Lilly Roth ferries survivors back to Wraeclast, beginning Part II.

name: Return to Oriath
summary: The Exile climbs the Ascent of Mt. Veruso, activates the Resonator and arrives in Oriath's Slave Pens; kills Overseer Krow to reach the rebel camp at Overseer's Tower where Lani rewards them.

name: Fallen from Grace (Act 6 start)
summary: First Part II quest.

name: Alano Phrecia defeats the dark being
summary: Alano sealed the dark being in 35 IC; darkness lifted.

name: Assassination of Chitus
summary: During the Night of a Thousand Ribbons celebration in Sarn, Victario's rebels ambushed the event. Mayor Ondar, who had gems implanted for it, betrayed Emperor Chitus and killed him.

sources.locator: section 'Assassination of Chitus' (ambush, Ondar betrayal; Origins footnotes)

alt_summaries.summary: Ondar kills Chitus; gemlings fall.

name: Commissioned by Kirac, the Exile Enters the Atlas
summary: After the campaign the Exile receives a tier-1 map from Commander Kirac, kills a map boss and is commissioned to aid the Citizen Vanguard.

name: The Conquerors Fall Into Madness
summary: Zana seals the Map Device; the Elderslayers split and each pursues their vice in the Atlas. Legacy epilogue quests Picking Up the Pieces / Chasing a Dream / The Crusader began with Kirac asking the Exile to find Baran.

sources.locator: start: 'Kirac's brother Baran has been driven insane and is lurking in the Atlas'

curation: codex audit round 2: Conquerors' madness is Elderslayers back-history, not a beat after the Exile's Elder victory

name: The Exile and Zana Expel the Elder
summary: The Exile lures the Elder to the centre of the Atlas and Zana uses the Cosmic Arcana to expel it; the Elder is defeated (Shaper route). Sirus's sacrifice belongs only to the Elderslayers version (event_atlas_elderslayers).

sources.locator: section 'The Elder and the Shaper' and 'Defeat of the Elder'

alt_summaries.summary: The Exile lures the Elder to the centre of the Atlas, Zana uses the Cosmic Arcana to expel it, and Sirus sacrifices himself to hold it in place.

curation: codex: merged duplicate mixed two versions

name: The Exile Defeats the Shaper
summary: After breaking the four Guardians, the Exile and Zana beat the Shaper in his Realm; he drops The Shaper's Key.

name: Zana's Elderslayers Hunt the Elder
summary: Parallel/earlier history (not the player Exile's route): Zana recruited Baran, Veritania, Drox, Al-Hezmin and Sirus as Elderslayers; in that version Sirus sacrifices himself to hold the Elder. It explains the Conquerors arc.
curation: codex: alternate history must not follow the Exile's Elder victory

name: The Envoy Introduces the Maven
summary: Map bosses killed under the Maven's witness earn her Beacon and Invitations.

name: Atlas Rework and Destroyed Atlas (3.28.0)
summary: March 2026 (Mirage league patch) reworked the Atlas: content physically on Atlas, one Voidstone from Exarch+Eater, third from Incarnation of Dread, Eagon now tries to stop Zana severing threads using Astrolabes.

name: Zana's Hidden Architect: the Shaper Hunt
summary: Legacy story: Zana sends the Exile into Shaper-influenced maps; seven memory fragments reveal the Shaper's origin as Valdo.

name: Siege of the Atlas: Exarch and Eater
summary: Eldritch Horrors (Searing Exarch, Eater of Worlds, Black Star, Infinite Hunger) approach; the Exile defeats their champions.

name: Sirus Awakens and Burns Oriath
summary: Sirus returns with a storm, builds his own device, burns Oriath; the Exile defeats him; Zana leaves the Atlas.

name: Atziri trapped in the crimson nightmare
summary: After the Cataclysm Atziri kept her beauty at the cost of her humanity, relegated to a nightmare realm where sacrificed Vaal rise and die repeatedly; her influence later seeps back via Vaal side areas and corruption.

name: Aul's Final Ritual
summary: In his last moments Aul rapidly crystallises his citadel with azurite, becoming the Crystal King.

sources.locator: Primeval civilization > Aul: 'In the final moments of his reign, he enacted the final ritual, encasing his palace in crystals'

name: Aul and Kulemak's Bargain
summary: Weakened Kulemak offers Aul 'untold power and mastery' for a single golem; the golem is infused with necromancy and the first Lightless/possessed golems result, ultimately toppling the primeval civilisation.

name: Aul's Uprising
summary: Aul, a slave, overthrows the tyrant Putembo and becomes the Crystal King.

name: Battle at the Grain Gate
summary: Rebel assault led by Victario with Templars, Ezomytes, Maraketh and Karui; repulsed by Chitus' gemlings, Marylene died shielding Victario.

name: Battle of Lioneye's Watch
summary: Kaom's ambush kills Lioneye.

name: Bloody Flowers Rebellion
summary: 1333 IC Ezomyte victory at Glarryn.

name: Surrender of Sarn
summary: Cadiro Perandus negotiates Sarn's unconditional surrender to Voll on 1 Sacrato of Phreci 1334 IC after stealing the treasury.

name: Chitus crowned Emperor
summary: Crowned 1319 IC; seals Izaro in.

name: Sin creates the Beast
summary: Sin planted the Dark Ember/Seed of Corruption beneath Highgate and nurtured it into the Beast to suppress the gods and end mortal ascension. PoE2 wiki adds that Sin sought Kalandra's cryptic advice and found the Seed in a Precursor ruin.

sources.locator: paragraph 2: Sin ... sought the ancient being Kalandra ... found a Precursor ruin containing the Seed of Corruption

alt_summaries.summary: Sin plants Dark Ember.

name: Cutting Off the Supply
summary: Betrayal-league Act 1 quest: Jun asks the Exile to help intercept an Immortal Syndicate transport in the Mud Flats. Quest removed in 3.6.0.

sources.locator: Header: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Betrayal league'; Version history 3.6.0 'Removed from the game'

name: Daresso leaves Oriath
summary: c. 1450 IC (History of Wraeclast); contradicts the use of his spirit's Eye of Desire in 1336 IC, which the wiki leaves unexplained.

name: Death of Geofri
summary: 1332 IC; Maligaro ambushes templars.

name: Kaom's march on Highgate and death
summary: Lured by the Beast's voice posing as Tukohama, Kaom led 500 warriors to Highgate and was deceived into slaying them before dying; his Eye of Fury was taken.

sources.locator: 'Lioneye's Watch' subsection, Kaom's march to Highgate

name: Death of Voll
summary: Voll fled to the Dried Lake after the Cataclysm, remained undead for centuries, and is killed by the exile in Act 4 (quest Breaking the Seal).

name: Defeat of Titucius
summary: 3rd Galvano of Vitali 1333 IC; Maraketh storm trap.

name: Deshret seals the mines
summary: Twenty years after Kaom.

name: Gemlings fall with Chitus
summary: With Chitus' death his master gem stopped and the legionnaires linked to his heartbeat died; Captain Alsarus' legion survived beyond the perimeter.

name: The Eater of Worlds (quest)
summary: Epilogue quest added in 3.17.0 and run in parallel with the Maven and Searing Exarch quests. The Envoy gives the Flesh Compass, which lets the Exile add Eater of Worlds influence to Tier 9 to 16 maps. The Tier 11 map boss drops a Writhing Invitation to the Infinite Hunger's arena (Seething Chyme); the Tier 16 map boss drops a Screaming Invitation to the Eater of Worlds' arena (Absence of Symmetry and Harmony). After The Infinite Hunger is defeated, the Atlas Book of Skill (Eldritch) is obtained; Kirac gives the Grasping Voidstone on completion. The Eater drops an Eldritch Voidstone if The Searing Exarch was defeated first.

chronology.relative: PoE1 endgame (3.17.0 Siege of the Atlas)

sources.locator: infobox (boss The Eater of Worlds) and Walkthrough: 'Use the Flesh Compass', 'Writhing Invitation', 'Screaming Invitation' steps; log 'You have obtained the Atlas Book of Skill (Eldritch)'; Defeat The Eater of Worlds: 'If the Searing Exarch was defeated first...'; version history 3.17.0

curation: codex: Eater climax missing from spine (parallel with Exarch/Maven quests)
codex audit round 2: parallel optional pinnacle quests

name: Einhar's Bestiary (Bestiary league quest)
summary: Act 1 optional quest exclusive to Bestiary league (3.2.0): Einhar Frey on The Coast asks the Exile to capture a beast with a net and keep a bestiary entry for each capture; he claims 'the animals in this land are sick'. Removed in 3.3.0.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Meet hunter-scavenger Einhar Frey on The Coast' to 'Quest Complete - You have unlocked the Bestiary'; Version history 3.2.0/3.3.0

name: Einhar's Hunt
summary: Optional Act 2 quest: started by Einhar Frey (Forest Encampment) and played in The Riverways, where the Exile captures all beasts; completing it unlocks The Menagerie.

sources.locator: quest infobox (start: Forest Encampment; completion: capture all beasts in The Riverways) and 'Walkthrough'

name: Einhar's Menagerie (quest)
summary: Optional Act 2 quest in The Menagerie: after Einhar's Hunt unlocks the Menagerie, the Exile talks to Einhar there and performs beastcrafting once.

sources.locator: quest infobox (objective: perform beastcrafting once; completion: talk to Einhar)

name: The Cataclysm
summary: c. 1339 IC; Malachai takes control of the Beast; Empire falls.

sources.locator: section 'The Cataclysm (~1339 IC)' and 'Reign of Voll'

alt_summaries.summary: Malachai uses the Rapture Device to breach the Belly of the Beast, triggering the Cataclysm around 1339 IC. It ends the Eternal Empire and Voll's reign, and its effects are mostly confined to the Wraeclast landmass.
Eternal Empire's destruction.

name: Sentencing of the Exiles by Oriath
summary: Criminals of Oriath are sentenced by the Templar Church for Sins (Letters of Exile lists charges, e.g. 1597-1599 IC) and shipped to Wraeclast by Dominus's Blackguards.

sources.locator: Format section: "You are hereby Exiled to Wraeclast..."

name: Exiles Sentenced to Wraeclast
summary: High Templar Dominus orders criminals of Oriath exiled to Wraeclast. The PoE1 Exile is one of the sentenced, washed up on the Twilight Strand, and escapes a Templar boat.
curation: codex: belongs at the start of the PoE1 spine

name: Exploring Kingsmarch
summary: Tutorial quest for Kingsmarch. Johan in Karui Shores sends the Exile into Kingsmarch, where Raulf explains recruitment and Johan handles placement and finances.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: start 'Arrive in the Karui Shores in the Epilogue', objective 'Learn about Kingsmarch', completion 'Speak to Johan'; Walkthrough: 'Introduce yourself to Raulf, hire a recruit, and then return to me'

name: Failed Kalguuran rebellion
summary: Rebellion against the King, referenced by Gwennen and implicated by letters involving Tujen, Rog and Dannig; survivors escaped to Wraeclast while Johan remembers Gwennen's face.

name: Fall of the Primeval Civilization
summary: The primeval civilisation is toppled by possessed golems (probably the Lightless), as the Winter of the World approaches.

name: First Kalguuran expedition to Wraeclast
summary: Expedition commissioned by Cadigan III after the Vaal Cataclysm 'Omen'; led by Olroth (Knights of the Sun), Uhtred (Order of the Chalice), Vorana (Black Scythe) and Medved (Druids of the Broken Circle); poisoned journey; colonisation; trade with Karui and Azmeri; gem panic; eventual collapse.

chronology.relative: Thousands of years before PoE1; soon after the Vaal Cataclysm

alt_summaries.summary: Centuries-old expedition ordered by Cadigan III including Knights of the Sun, Black Scythe, Druids of the Broken Circle, Priests of the Chalice and Remembrancers; it taught the Ezomytes runesmithing and ended in tragedy.

name: Founding of the Order of the Djinn
summary: Ahkeli and a dekhara of surviving Maraketh found the Order, using golems and relics of power to push back the Lightless and save the Vastiri Plains.

name: Founding of Oriath
summary: Templars banished from the Azmeri found Oriath.

name: Awakening of the gods
summary: Killing the Beast in Act 4 woke the dormant gods (Kitava, Tukohama, Abberath, Ryslatha, Brine King, Gruthkul, Arakaali, Garukhan, Shakari, Solaris, Lunaris...), setting up PoE1 Part 2.

sources.locator: last paragraph: 'Following the actions of the player in Act 4 ... the old Gods (such as Kitava) are awakened'

name: Great Fire
summary: Ezomyte cataclysm: the First Ones, unhonoured, spill fire out of a mountain; leaders turned to ash, survivors fed on tainted grain from Mother Gull. PoE2 reveals it is the Winter of the World.

name: Great Wasting
summary: Karui name for the apocalyptic age of horror and famine also called the Great Fire (Ezomyte) and Winter of the World (Maraketh); Karui ancestors and Maraketh gods are said to emerge in it.

name: Imperialis Conceptus
summary: Founding of the Eternal Empire (1 IC).

alt_summaries.summary: Tarcus Veruso leads the Azmeri down into the lands left by the Vaal and founds Sarn at 1 IC, marking the start of the Eternal calendar and the Eternal Empire.

name: Incursions into Atzoatl
summary: Alva Valai creates incursions that take the Exile 2,000 years back to the Temple of Atzoatl; changes alter the present temple.

name: Innocence's true ascension (Sanctum relic account)
summary: Lore revealed through Sanctum unique relics: Sin and Innocence were brothers among the Azmeri; Innocence founded a religion on fear of the 'cleansing fire' and the newcomers' symbol, branded Sin the embodiment of sin, and both ascended (Sin ashen, Innocence golden), until the Azmeri drove Innocence's followers off the mountains. Contradicts the Templar 'mother of two' propaganda.

sources.locator: [24:37]-[32:00] Lycia's relic text account; [43:03]-[44:30] mother of two as fabrication

name: Into the Breach
summary: Act 6 tutorial quest for the Breach mechanic. Ailith's flame burns the Hiveborn barrier at the Mud Flats entrance; the Exile then bonds the Genesis Tree at the Monastery of the Keepers. Introduced in 3.27.0; the 3.28.0 Keepers rework replaced the original Breach mechanic.

sources.locator: Quest info: 'Into the Breach is the a tutorial quest for Breach'; Walkthrough 'Burn away the barrier the Hiveborn built'; Walkthrough 'Allocate a Womb on the Genesis Tree'; Version history 3.28.0 'replaced the original Breech mechanic' and 3.27.0 'Introduced to the game'

name: Into The Nexus
summary: Act 1 quest exclusive to the Synthesis league: Cavas has the Exile connect collected memories to the Memory Nexus and explore them. Quest removed in 3.7.0.

sources.locator: Quest info: start 'Talk to Cavas', completion 'You have explored the connected memories'; Version history 3.6.0 'Introduced', 3.7.0 'Removed from the game'

name: Kalandra Trapped in the Lake
summary: Kalandra enters the primordial lake out of curiosity and can never leave: every escape returns her to the lake with no memory.

sources.locator: Lore: Ancient Etchings; History of Wraeclast 'The Lake of Kalandra'

alt_summaries.summary: Kalandra entered the Lake out of curiosity in the primordial era and found herself unable to leave, forgetting each attempt.

name: Kalguuran Expedition to Wraeclast
summary: After the Vaal Cataclysm's omens, King Cadigan III sends an expedition with the Triskelion Flame led by Olroth, Uhtred, Vorana and Medved; they colonise Vaal ruins, until horrors, a priesthood plot and the loss of the Flame destroy the colony.

alt_summaries.summary: After the Vaal Cataclysm, a Kalguur expedition (led by Olroth, Uhtred, Vorana and Medved) arrives, colonises, and collapses. The Triskelion Flame is lost and famine follows; the wiki says who sabotaged the port is unknown.

name: Kaom at Highgate
summary: Kaom slays his 500 warriors deceived by the Beast.

name: Keepers / Mirage / Allflame leagues (2025-26)
summary: 2025-26 challenge leagues (Keepers 3.27.0, Mirage 3.28.0, Allflame 3.29.0) do not continue the Atlas story directly; Keepers continues Breach lore.

name: Founding of Kingsmarch
summary: When a Kalguuran outpost in Wraeclast reached a certain size, the King gifted it an official Charter and the name Kingsmarch and sent Johan as King's Hand; the Exile joins and invests Gold in the town's treasury and services (PoE1 3.25-3.26).

name: Kirac Seeks His Brother Baran (legacy)
summary: Legacy (3.9-3.16) epilogue quests: Kirac enlists the Exile to find his brother Baran, who joined Zana Caeserius's expedition; the Map Device is rebuilt from components in the Vault of Venarius and Zana appears in the Atlas, leading to the Elderslayers/Conquerors storyline. Removed in 3.17.

name: Kitava invited into Wraeclast
summary: Karui carvings say the Eternals opened the gate and invited Kitava into the land; Kitava cut the Karui off from the Ancestors. Haku adds that the Karui also had a hand in the downfall.

sources.locator: Weathered Carving in Kaom's Stronghold; Haku 'The Karui and Wraeclast'

name: Contract: Hyrri's Gift
summary: Kurai's client contract to retrieve 'O' Eternal', the book Victario gifted Queen Hyrri, from an Oriathan nobleman's vault. The Exile completes the theft; Kurai then promises to return the book to Ngamakanui. The theft leads to Vic Vox's grievance against Kurai.

sources.locator: 'Hyrri's Gift' section (Kaom/Hyrri background and contract text); Lore paragraph

name: Contract: The Negotiation
summary: Kurai and the Exile travel to meet the Vox twins over the stolen 'O' Eternal. Kurai says the book is no longer in her possession; Vic Vox declares war on her and the meeting ends with the Vox twins at war with Kurai. Hana, Kurai's cat, is taken afterwards.

sources.locator: 'The Negotiation' section (In-Quest Text) and 'Returned To Rogue Harbour'

name: Contract: The Rescue
summary: The Vox twins offer to return Hana and negotiate a truce if Kurai and the Exile meet them in person again. The second meeting ends in hostility (Kurai's counter-proposal is to kill both twins); afterwards Kurai learns the Vox twins killed Hana, and The Boss orders the Vox family dead.

sources.locator: 'The Rescue' section and 'Return To Rogue Harbour' ('They killed Hana')
'Lore': Vic kidnaps and later slaughters Hana

name: Contract: The Twins
summary: Final contract of Kurai's questline (unique, tradeable, restartable): Kurai and the Exile strike the Vox twins after Ring intelligence that the twins will unite for a celebration, and kill Vic Vox and Vinny Vox at the Mansion. The Boss authorises a bonus for the Exile.

sources.locator: 'The Twins' sections (Kurai contract four), 'Vic Vox' and 'Vinny Vox' monster boxes
monster box (location Mansion; quest Contract: The Twins); lead

name: Contract: Trial Run (Rogue Harbour)
summary: Kurai's first job for the Ring in the Rogue Harbour introductory quest: after Kurai hands out the contract the Exile speaks to the rogue Karst, opens a portal to the contract zone via Adiyah, completes the contract and sells the Heist target to Faustus. Kurai is first accessible in Act 6 from patch 3.13.0.

chronology.relative: 3.12.0 Heist league quest; Kurai from Act 6 (3.13.0)

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Take the Contract: Trial Run from Kurai' to 'Sell the Heist target to Faustus'

name: Lighting the Way
summary: Act 7 quest: the Exile gathers seven Fireflies in the Dread Thicket and delivers them to Yeena, who brews Fire Dew to burn open the entrance to Arakaali's temple.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: start 'Take the first Firefly in the Dread Thicket', completion 'Talk to Yeena'; Walkthrough: 'Yeena needs seven Fireflies to burn open the entrance to Arakaali's temple'

curation: codex audit round 2: required quest before Arakaali

name: Lightless Invasion
summary: After ash blocked the sun, the Lightless surface and devastate the primeval civilisation, felled Titans and the Maraketh/Azmeri cultures; a coalition under the Third Pact opposes them.

sources.locator: intro; The Winter of the World

name: Opening of the Lord's Labyrinth
summary: Izaro opens the maze on 1317 IC; Chitus and Weylin enter; Chitus poisons Weylin.

name: Lord's Labyrinth Opened
summary: Izaro opens the Lord's Labyrinth on the second Galvano of Azmeri, 1317 IC. Chitus wins it by betraying Weylin, and then seals Izaro inside.

sources.locator: section 'The Lord's Labyrinth' and 'Reign of Chitus'

name: Lost Voidstones (quest)
summary: Hidden Epilogue quest that appears only if the Exile previously obtained and then dropped a Voidstone, or migrated Atlas progress from one league to another. It is completed by talking to Commander Kirac and is not shown on the World Map.

sources.locator: infobox (required=no, start 'Automatic', objective 'Talk to Kirac to recover your lost Voidstones'); Walkthrough: 'It is only visible if the player has previously obtained then dropped one or more Voidstones, or migrated Atlas progress'

name: Lycia's pact with Beidat
summary: Lycia, shocked by the unnamed discarded bones of the Templar ossuary and the true origin of Innocence, called Beidat and traded her freedom for immortality inside the Sanctum, giving the Scourge a foothold in Wraeclast.

name: Maiden Voyage
summary: Act 1 tutorial for the Curse of the Allflame league: Valerie the Corsair invites the Exile aboard the Sovereign as First Mate, after the Coast waypoint starts the quest.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: act 1, objective 'Explore the depths of the ocean'; 'a tutorial quest for Curse of the Allflame'; Walkthrough: 'Valerie has asked you to be her First Mate'

name: Malachai spared by Voll
summary: Malachai promises end of thaumaturgy.

name: Maraketh Golden Age
summary: Roughly a thousand years of glory after Solerai and Lundara expelled the Lightless, in a lush Vastiri of seven rivers; ended when the Beast silenced the gods.

name: Medved's challenge
summary: A two-axe horror leader (recognised by Vorana as her beloved Medved) killed 42 challengers in 42 days; Vorana ordered a retreat; two villages fell.

name: Night of a Thousand Ribbons
summary: Burning of Sarn in protest against Romira; later festival where Chitus was assassinated.

alt_summaries.summary: Around 334 IC, Sarn burns in protest at Emperor Romira's cannibal banquet and incest, and Romira is deposed. The date is still celebrated after reconstruction.

name: Order of the Djinn Forsake Kalandra
summary: The Order of the Djinn swears to free Kalandra and devotes itself to her artefacts of power, but 'once they understood the truth of this place' its scribes try to erase her from history, burning their books (Kalandra page: and self-immolating out of fear); the History page words it as forsaking and abandoning her.

sources.locator: Lore > Ancient Etchings: 'burning their books and self-immolating out of fear'

name: Oriath destroyed by Sirus
summary: PoE1 Conquerors of the Atlas: Oriath is completely destroyed by Sirus, leaving it devastated; PoE2 states the world believed Oriath abandoned twenty years ago after crises.

alt_summaries.summary: Sirus used his own map device to enter Oriath and burn it down; Kirac took a blow meant for Zana; the Exile defeated him. In Siege timeline an unknown exile dealt Sirus a near-fatal blow at the cost of her life.

name: Original Sin (Innocence's ascension)
summary: Per Lycia's relics, twin brothers Innocence and Sin lived among the Azmeri; Innocence, unable to attract enough followers, turned his followers against Sin and used their hatred to ascend, leaving Sin blackened. The Templar stained-glass version is propaganda.

sources.locator: section on Forbidden Sanctum relics / Lycia's findings; 'Original Sin' unique
[24:43]-[25:12] Lycia's story of Sin and Innocence among the Azmeri

alt_summaries.summary: Innocence turns followers against Sin.

name: Oshabi's exile from the Azmeri
summary: Oshabi, hearing the land demand a sacrifice, offered a child to the earth; her tribe stopped it, the land fell silent, and the Azmeri exiled her and forbade her name.

name: Perpetual Night over the Imperial Heartlands
summary: Azmerian writers describe part of the empire cast into perpetual night, a 'dark being' dismembering Emperor Caspiro, until General Alano Phrecia dispelled it, 'returning the gaze of Solaris'. Likely the darkness later sealed in the Oversoul (per GGG Q&A).

chronology.relative: Caspiro died ~5 years after Veruso; Alano Phrecia quote dated first Sacrato of Lurici, 35 IC

sources.locator: Alano Phrecia quote: '... our legions drove the dark being deep into the recesses of its lair and sealed it away for eternity' (35 IC)

name: Plague of Ezomyr
summary: At some point most of Ezomyr was wiped out by a plague (per Kahuturoa), after Oriath was recently established.

name: Divinia and the Mortinomicon
summary: Divinia asks the exile to retrieve the Mortinomicon from the Ossuary; this leads to the Forbidden Sanctum.

name: Return to Oriath
summary: Lilly Roth ferries the exile to Oriath Docks; Lani describes Vilenta's betrayal.

name: Innocence Breaks Kitava's Horns
summary: Innocence destroys the black gates blocking the Canals.

name: The Exile Kills Kitava
summary: In the Feeding Trough, with Sin and Innocence's help, the exile kills Kitava and unlocks the Epilogue; Sin: 'you are no exile'.

alt_summaries.summary: In Act 10 the Exile and Sin, with Innocence re-awakened by Bannon's sacrifice, defeat Kitava. The Exile had earlier failed to defeat Kitava atop the Cathedral.

name: No Love for Old Ghosts
summary: Optional Act 10 quest: Weylam Roth sends the exile to the Ossuary for Atziri's Elixir of Allure, a love potion kept in the skull of her favourite lover, which Templars had looted.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Weylam on Queen Atziri's love potion

name: The Exile Rescues Bannon
summary: The exile saves Bannon from Kitava's cultists on the Cathedral Rooftop.

name: Bannon Resurrects Innocence
summary: Bannon uses the Staff of Avarius and sacrifices himself to host the reborn Innocence.

name: Vilenta's Vengeance
summary: Optional: the exile kills the monstrous Vilenta in the Control Blocks.

name: Defeat the Vaal Oversoul
summary: Exile kills the Oversoul in the Ancient Pyramid and lifts the Darkness.

name: Clearing the Twilight Strand
summary: Lilly Roth asks the exile to clear drowned Oriathan undead from the Twilight Strand.

name: The Exile Kills Abberath
summary: Bestel's request leads to Abberath's death in the Valley of the Fire Drinker.

name: The Exile Kills the Brine King
summary: Following Nessa, the exile sails on the Black Crest to the reef and kills the Brine King, unlocking Act 7.

name: The Exile Kills Ryslatha
summary: The exile destroys the Puppet Mistress's nest on Tarkleigh's request.

name: Harvesting Shavronne's Soul
summary: The exile kills Shavronne's spirit in Axiom Prison; Sin harvests her soul for the Dark Ember.

name: The Father of War
summary: Required Act 6 quest. The Exile finds the missing Eye of Conquest (from the Dishonoured Queen), enters the Karui Fortress and Tukohama's Keep, and kills Tukohama, the Karui god of war. Sin then introduces the Pantheon. The quest completes when Tarkleigh rewards the Exile in Lioneye's Watch.

sources.locator: infobox: boss 'Tukohama, Karui God of War', key item 'Eye of Conquest', completion 'Talk to Tarkleigh after Tukohama is defeated'; walkthrough: 'After you defeat him, Sin will come and introduce the Pantheon'; Tarkleigh: 'You've killed the Karui war god?'

alt_summaries.summary: The exile obtains the missing eye, reaches Tukohama's Keep and kills the Karui war god; Sin appears and introduces the Pantheon.

curation: pin after merging duplicate quest node The Father of War

name: Return to Wraeclast
summary: The exile arrives at Lioneye's Watch aboard Lilly Roth's ship, and Sin tasks them with harvesting souls to birth the Dark Ember; the Pantheon is later introduced.

name: The Exile Kills Arakaali
summary: The exile burns open Arakaali's temple via Yeena's Fire Dew and kills her, failing to save Silk.

name: The Exile Kills Gruthkul
summary: Sin sends the exile into the Dread Thicket to kill the grieving goddess.

name: Harvesting Maligaro's Soul
summary: The exile kills Maligaro's essence in his sanctum; Sin gains his soul.
curation: codex audit round 2: Maligaro precedes Ralakesh (Silk's key)

name: Ralakesh and Greust
summary: The exile kills the possessed Greust to drive Ralakesh back into the relic.
curation: codex audit round 2: after Web of Secrets

name: The Master of a Million Faces
summary: Required Act 7 quest. Eramir reads the Vaal inscriptions on the relic that washed ashore and identifies the god Ralakesh. Ralakesh has possessed Greust; killing Greust forces the god back into the relic, and destroying the relic may destroy the god. The route to the Old Fields runs through a secret passage from the Chamber of Sins, whose key Silk gives after Maligaro's map boss.

sources.locator: infobox: boss 'Ralakesh, Master of a Million Faces', start 'Talk to Eramir in the Bridge Encampment'; Eramir: 'Our poor friend, Greust, has likely become Ralakesh's avatar'; walkthrough: 'The key to this passage is given to you by Silk after you defeat Maligaro in the map device'

name: The Mother of Spiders
summary: Required Act 7 quest. After Silk's strange dialogue, Yeena sends the Exile to Arakaali's temple (Temple of Decay) to save Silk. The Exile kills Arakaali, which opens Act 8, but fails to save Silk.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Talk to Yeena', boss Arakaali, completion 'Go to Act 8'; walkthrough: 'Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay to save Silk'; Quest Complete: 'You have killed Arakaali and gained access to Act 8, but failed to save Silk.'

name: Queen of Despair
summary: Optional Act 7 quest. Sin sends the Exile into the Den of Despair in the Dread Thicket to kill Gruthkul, the Mother of Despair, whose children the Vaal slaughtered. Eramir rewards the Exile and records the story in a book.

sources.locator: infobox: boss 'Gruthkul, Mother of Despair', start 'Talk to Sin', completion 'Talk to Eramir', required 'no'; walkthrough: 'Into the most dreaded of thickets you must go ... Gruthkul the Despairing sulks and schemes'

name: The Silver Locket
summary: Optional Act 7 quest. Weylam Roth asks the Exile to find the Silver Locket, which holds a portrait of his late wife Meredith, buried in a lockbox near the Broken Bridge. Delivering it earns a reward; since 3.15.0 the reward is a choice of flask.

sources.locator: infobox: act 7, start 'Talk to Weylam Roth in the Bridge Encampment', required 'No'; walkthrough: 'buried near the Broken Bridge'; Weylam Roth: 'The box has a silver locket in it, holds the portrait of me late wife, Meredith'; Version history 3.15.0 flask choice

name: Web of Secrets
summary: Act 7 quest: Silk asks the exile to take the venom of Black Death, Maligaro's pet spider, which is killed together with Maligaro in his Sanctum; Silk's strange talk afterwards leads to the Mother of Spiders quest.

sources.locator: Intro: Silk's strange dialogue at the end of Web of Secrets

curation: codex audit round 2: required quest missing from spine

name: The Gemling Legion Rises
summary: Optional Act 8 quest: Maramoa has seen a Gemling Legion Captain gathering gemling legionnaires (once Emperor Chitus's personal swords) at the Grain Gate; the exile kills them, leaving Maramoa fearful that other Undying may regain sentience.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Maramoa on the Grain Gate

name: Harvesting Doedre's Soul
summary: The exile kills Doedre in the Cauldron of the Cesspool; Sin harvests her soul.

name: The Exile Kills Solaris and Lunaris
summary: With the Sun and Moon Orbs the exile summons and kills both goddesses at the Harbour Bridge, unlocking Act 9.

name: The Exile Kills Yugul
summary: The exile kills the fear-god Yugul in the High Gardens.

name: Lunar Eclipse
summary: Act 8 required quest: Maramoa sends the Exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Moon Orb, one of the two ancient treasures needed to confront Lunaris and Solaris.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Find a way through the Sewers so you can search for the Moon Orb'; Maramoa: 'there exists a pair of ancient treasures, the Sun Orb and the Moon Orb. They are our hope… our desperation.'

curation: codex audit round 2: required, parallel with Solar Eclipse

name: Solar Eclipse
summary: Act 8 required quest: Maramoa sends the Exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Sun Orb, the counterpart of the Moon Orb, needed to confront Solaris and Lunaris.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Find a way through the Sewers so you can search for the Sun Orb'; Maramoa: 'there exists a pair of ancient treasures, the Sun Orb and the Moon Orb. They are our hope… our desperation.'

curation: codex audit round 2: required, parallel with Lunar Eclipse

name: Tolman's Failed Resurrection
summary: Clarissa's ritual with the Ankh fails; the exile must kill the resurrected Tolman.

name: Entering the Beast's Belly
summary: Sin burns a new entrance into the Beast's corpse using Basilisk acid and mining powder.

name: The Exile Kills the Depraved Trinity
summary: The three harvested souls merge into the Depraved Trinity in the Rotting Core and are destroyed; Lilly then offers passage to Oriath.

name: Kira's Rite and Garukhan's Death
summary: The exile kills Kira and Garukhan but fails to save Oyun; the Feather goes to Tasuni or Irasha.

name: The Exile Kills Shakari
summary: Using Garukhan's bottled storm the exile clears the sandstorm and kills Shakari.

name: Recurring Nightmare
summary: Required Act 9 quest. Sin asks the Exile to gather Basilisk Acid and Trarthan Powder (Refinery, Boiling Lake) so he can burn a new entrance into the Beast. The Exile meets Sin at the Quarry, enters the Belly of the Beast, and kills the Depraved Trinity; Lilly Roth then offers to ferry the Exile to Oriath for Act 10.

sources.locator: walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin in Highgate about the Beast and what to do'; 'Meet Sin at the Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance into the Belly of the Beast'; completion: 'You have killed the Depraved Trinity. Now talk to Lilly to gain access to Act 10'; Lilly Roth: 'Say the words and we'll set the sails.'

curation: codex audit round 2: required Act 9 quest

name: The Ruler of Highgate
summary: Optional Act 9 quest. Kira has kidnapped Oyun to sacrifice her to Garukhan. The Exile kills Kira and Garukhan but cannot save Oyun; the Sekhema Feather is then given to Tasuni or Irasha (the Exile's choice), who rules Highgate. The reward is a Book of Skill.

sources.locator: lead: 'an optional quest in act 9'; walkthrough: 'Kira has kidnapped Oyun and plans to sacrifice her to Garukhan'; completion lines: 'You have given the Sekhema Feather to Tasuni and he now rules Highgate' / 'to Irasha and she now rules Highgate'; 'failed to save Oyun'

name: A Choice of Futures
summary: Tutorial quest for the Ultimatum mechanic (Ultimatum league). In a map, the Exile approaches an entity of Chaos, chooses one of the Trialmaster's challenges, completes the round without leaving the ritual circle, and decides whether to raise the difficulty or leave with the current reward.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Any map with Trialmaster', objective 'Start Ultimatum encounter'; walkthrough: 'Your path has led you to an entity of Chaos. Approach him.'; 'Complete the Trialmaster's (round number) challenge without leaving the ritual circle'

name: Karui Shores and the Atlas of Worlds
summary: The exile reaches Karui Shores and starts mapping.

name: The Eldritch Decay
summary: Final Atlas quest given by Zana in the epilogue. The Exile spreads Elder influence to the four Tier 16 Shaper Guardian maps so the Elder spawns in the Shaper's Realm, then defeats the Elder Guardians and the Uber Elder. Removed from the game in 3.9.0 when the Atlas mechanic was reworked (introduced 3.2.0).

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Talk to Zana', completion 'Talk to Zana', act 'Epilogue'; section 'Walkthrough': 'Defeat the Elder (Uber Elder)'; Version history 3.9.0 'Removed from the game'

name: Oriath after Kitava (older Epilogue, v3.9-3.16)
summary: Historical content (removed in 3.17): in the earlier Epilogue the exile talks to Officer Kirac in rebuilding Oriath, who asks them to investigate his brother Baran's disappearance and Zana at the Templar Laboratory, leading to the Vault of Venarius and a rebuilt Map Device. Kitava's skull is displayed in Oriath (Epilogue).

sources.locator: Gallery: Kitava's skull on display in Oriath (Epilogue)

name: The Sacred Grove (quest)
summary: Introductory quest for the Harvest mechanic. After the Exile finds the Sacred Grove, Oshabi teaches the Exile to harvest the Grove's seeds (Wild, Vivid and Primal Lifeforce pools), kill the monsters that emerge, and talk to her about the harvest. Reworked in 3.13.0.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'The Sacred Grove', objective 'Talk to Oshabi about how to harvest the Grove's seeds', act 'Epilogue'; quest logs: 'Activate the Lifeforce Collector ... Kill the monsters that have emerged from the Seeds'; Version history 3.13.0 'Reworked'
section 'Quests': 'Oshabi offers players the following quest: The Sacred Grove'

name: Sailing Away from Oriath
summary: After Kitava's death Lilly Roth, in a class-specific line, offers to sail the exile away from Oriath and the quest 'Toward the Future' leads to the Epilogue.

name: The Memory Eater
summary: Epilogue quest given by Zana. The Exile must collect 15 Memory Fragments by killing the bosses of Elder-influenced Atlas maps; each fragment can be exchanged for a Shaper's Orb, and each turn-in earns Zana reputation, and fragments II to X also earn a map of the same tier as the fragment. Removed in 3.9.0.

sources.locator: lead paragraph: 'a quest given by Zana in the story's epilogue ... collect 15 Memory Fragments by killing the bosses of 15 maps'; infobox start 'Speak to Zana'; Version history 3.9.0 'Removed from the game'

name: The Redeemer (quest)
summary: Epilogue Atlas quest in which Zana's former colleague Veritania has gone insane and lurks in corner-region maps of the Atlas. The Exile finds her three times, then uses Kirac's information and Zana's portals to enter her Citadel and defeat Veritania the Redeemer. Reworked for 3.16 when the Atlas was reduced to four regions; removed in 3.17.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Complete The Elderslayers', boss 'Veritania'; walkthrough: 'The third time you do, Veritania will appear and taunt the player'; 'talk to Kirac ... talk to Zana to open six portals into Veritania's Citadel'; Version history: reworked as regions reduced to 4; removed in 3.17

name: The Lost Expedition (quest)
summary: Act 6 quest started by Dannig: the exile finds ancient Kalguuran texts and learns the expedition's story. The Triskelion Flame is located and destroyed in defeating Olroth. Introduced in Expedition league (3.15.0).

name: Pound of Flesh
summary: Epilogue Metamorph-league quest. Tane Octavius asks the Exile to slay monsters and collect five different Metamorph organ samples; the samples summon a Metamorph which the Exile defeats. Afterwards Tane can be invited to the hideout and the Tane's Laboratory is accessible.

sources.locator: infobox: act 'Epilogue', start 'Map', objective 'Tane wants you to slay creatures and collect samples ... five different samples'; walkthrough: 'Your samples have summoned a Metamorph! Defeat it.'; 'the player character can access the Tane's Laboratory after the quest'

name: Shattered Past
summary: Act 1 quest exclusive to the Synthesis league (historical; removed in 3.7.0). Cavas, an amnesiac, asks the Exile to explore and stabilise a corrupted memory and find more memories; once he remembers enough, the Exile is given access to the Memory Nexus.

sources.locator: lead: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Synthesis league'; Cavas: 'Oh. Oh dear. Oh DEAR! I've remembered something! Exile, it is time we go to the Nexus.'; 'Quest Complete - You have gained access to the Memory Nexus'

name: Strange Growths
summary: Blight tutorial quest (Act 3 or any Blight encounter). Sister Cassia asks the Exile to activate her Ichor Pump; the Exile builds towers near the Mycelium and defends the pump from Fungal Defenders. Completing it unlocks Anointing.

sources.locator: infobox: act 3, start 'Any Map (except Blighted Map) with the presence of Cassia'; walkthrough: 'Build a Tower near the Mycelium to help protect Cassia's pump'; 'Quest Complete - You have helped Cassia defend her Ichor Pump'; quest unlocks 'anointing'

name: The Undertaker's Apprentice
summary: Tutorial quest for the Necropolis league mechanic. The Exile kills monsters until a usable corpse drops, buries it in The Necropolis, performs the exorcism by digging the grave, and returns to Undertaker Arimor to end the quest.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Approach Undertaker Arimor', objective 'Collect corpse / Perform the Exorcism in The Necropolis', completion 'Talk to Undertaker Arimor', act 1; walkthrough: 'Perform the Exorcism by digging the grave in the Necropolis'

name: Gods awaken after the Beast's death
summary: About 20 years before PoE2 an exile killed the Beast, waking the slumbering gods, who per the Twilight Order now make civilisation impossible.

name: Precursor Cataclysm
summary: After mastering corruption the Precursors delved into world secrets, triggering great fires, eruptions and impacts from the sky; the civilisation was wiped out by an unknown cataclysm. Cause unclear.

name: Priesthood conspiracy (stabbing of Olroth)
summary: High Priest Uhtred, suspecting Olroth of fighting for the horrors in his sleep, had a dozen priests stab him (71 wounds); Vorana killed all twelve; Olroth was encased in glass and Uhtred fled to an ancient site of power.

name: Purity Rebellion
summary: A rebellion led by High Templar Voll and the poet Victario, with King Kaom, Sekhema Deshret and Thane Rigwald. It culminates in the siege of Sarn (Divini, 1334 IC) and Voll's coronation.

sources.locator: sections 'The Purity Rebellion', 'Siege of Sarn', 'Assassination of Chitus'
issues #1-4 (Death to Sin / The Black Heart)

alt_summaries.summary: Voll's crusade against Gemlings.

name: Rapture Device activation
summary: 1336 IC; Dialla refuses; Malachai enters Beast.

name: Return of the Sun
summary: The Winter of the World ends: Maraketh tradition credits twin sekhema Solerai and Lundara expelling the Lightless; official Abyss text credits Solaris. Sources differ (possibly the same figures).

sources.locator: The Lightless final paragraph; The Maraketh

name: The Searing Exarch (quest)
summary: Epilogue quest added in 3.17.0 and run in parallel with The Maven and The Eater of Worlds quests. The Envoy gives the Luminous Astrolabe, which lets the Exile add Searing Exarch influence to Tier 9 to 16 maps. The Tier 11 map boss drops a Polaric Invitation to the Black Star's arena (area level 79); the Tier 16 map boss drops an Incandescent Invitation to the Searing Exarch's arena (The Absence of Patience and Wisdom). The Black Star is defeated first, then the Searing Exarch. The quest pays out Atlas passive points (2 skill points, 4 respec points on completion) and an Omniscient Voidstone via Kirac; the Exarch drops an Eldritch Voidstone if The Eater of Worlds was defeated first.

chronology.relative: PoE1 endgame (3.17.0 Siege of the Atlas)

sources.locator: infobox (boss The Searing Exarch) and Walkthrough: quest intro 'This quest runs in parallel to The Maven (quest) and The Eater of Worlds (quest)'; 'Use the Luminous Astrolabe', 'Polaric Invitation', 'Incandescent Invitation' steps; Quest Complete log 'You have gained 2 Atlas Passive Skill Points and 4 Atlas Passive Respec Points'; version history 3.17.0

curation: codex: Exarch climax missing from spine (parallel with Eater/Maven quests)
codex audit round 2: parallel optional pinnacle quests

name: Siege of Sarn
summary: On the last day of Divini 1334 IC, High Templar Voll laid siege to Sarn with Ezomyte, Karui and Maraketh rebel support. Cadiro Perandus negotiated Sarn's surrender on 1 Sacrato of Phreci 1334 IC, and Voll was crowned a week later.

sources.locator: section 'Siege of Sarn (Divini, 1334 IC)' and the paragraph after 'Assassination of Chitus' (surrender and coronation)

alt_summaries.summary: Divini 1334 IC; Voll besieges Sarn.

name: Sin Consults Kalandra
summary: Sin seeks Kalandra at her lake and receives cryptic instructions leading him to a Precursor ruin holding the Seed of Corruption, used to create the Beast. Etching V's 'little thief' is read as Sin; PoE1 link is inference, PoE2 wiki states it directly.

name: Slumber of the Gods
summary: Sin plants the Dark Ember in Highgate, creating the Beast, the source of thaumaturgy. The Beast initiates the Slumber of the Gods, which puts all gods to sleep.

name: Slumbering of the Gods
summary: Sin's Beast lulled the gods into dreamless slumber, ending an era of divine strife; Hinekora foresaw it and prepared the Halls of the Dead before sleeping.

chronology.relative: unknown, millennia before PoE1 (before the Vaal Empire per PoE2 wiki)

sources.locator: Sin 'The Rise of the Gods': "We gods, we were driven into slumbering darkness, to dream away eternity whilst the gentle Beast watched over us."
Hinekora dream: 'She foresaw the Slumbering of the Gods' / hinekora wiki Lore

name: Memory of the Templar Laboratory
summary: Tier-5+ Synthesis memory in which Cavas sees High Templar Venarius and the scientist Valdo Caeserius building something together; Venarius lashes out, triggering the realisation of Cavas's identity.

chronology.relative: Past of the Templar Laboratory, shortly before Valdo's imprisonment

name: Templars shift to Oriath
summary: After the Cataclysm.

name: Templar Theocracy of Oriath
summary: After the Cataclysm, the Templars shift their base to Oriath and develop a theocracy. The Templar Courts and Chamber of Innocence are built under High Templar Avarius shortly before PoE1.

name: The Maven's Game (quest)
summary: Epilogue quest that starts when the Exile enters Absence of Mercy and Empathy with a Maven's Writ; it culminates in the Maven pinnacle boss fight. Defeating the Maven unlocks the Ceremonial Voidstone (reported to Commander Kirac); the quest's final steps have the Exile use an Atlas Book of Skill for 1 Atlas passive skill point and 2 Atlas passive respec points.

sources.locator: infobox (required=no, start 'Obtain a The Maven's Writ', completion 'Defeat The Maven') and Walkthrough: quest-log lines 'Challenge the Maven', 'Talk to Commander Kirac', 'Use the Atlas Book of Skill'; version history 3.13.0 'Introduced to the game'
Walkthrough, final paragraph: after the final invitation the player forms 'The Maven's Writ which is used to challenge The Maven'

curation: codex: Maven confrontation missing from Atlas spine
codex audit round 2: parallel optional pinnacle quests

name: The Rogue Harbour (quest)
summary: Act 6 introductory quest for the Heist mechanic: after Kurai and a Rogue's Marker, the Exile opens a portal to The Rogue Harbour, takes Contract: Trial Run from Kurai and finishes it with Karst.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: act 6, required no, start 'Lioneye's Watch (Act 6)', completion 'Talk to Kurai after finishing the contract'; Version history 3.12.0 'Introduced to the game'

name: Threads of the Originator
summary: Epilogue quest starting the Secrets of the Atlas storyline; the Exile follows Memory Threads with Eagon to find the Originator.

alt_summaries.summary: Eagon and the Exile chase Zana's memory threads, defeat the Incarnations of Neglect, Fear and Dread; the Atlas is shattered.

name: Titans and Humans Fight the Rising Darkness
summary: A 'rising darkness' (likely the Lightless after the Winter of the World) attacks Titans and humans; surviving Titans forge weapons and unearth the first virtue gem, but are almost wiped out.

name: Toward the Future
summary: Act 10 quest closing the campaign: after defeating Kitava, Lilly Roth in Oriath Docks offers to sail the Exile away; completing it is 'Set Sail from Oriath'.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: act 10, start 'Talk to Lilly Roth in Oriath Docks', completion 'Set Sail from Oriath'; Walkthrough: 'Talk to Lilly Roth after defeating Kitava'

name: Merchant Wars and War of the Great Families
summary: Feud between House Keita and House Bardiya that escalated into civil war and ended in a ceasefire and the Merchant Council.

name: Trarthan Rebellion against Phrecius (870 IC)
